Experiment Zero |occupation = Ultimate killing monster |powers = Cyborg enhancements, repairing android minions and spaceships |likes = Causing destruction, power, leadership |dislikes = Being captured, disloyalty, hard choices |status = Captured |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Experiment 000''' (pronounced as "'''Experiment Zero'''"), or simply '''Zero''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and his earliest experiment before he began working with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] and numbering his genetic creations. He is designed to be an ultimate killing monster and has enhanced his body with cybernetics at some point after escaping imprisonment. He appears as a minor antagonist in the second season of the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. ==Background== ===Personality=== As [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] created him to be the ultimate killing monster, Zero is ruthless, brutal, cruel, ambitious, destructive, and sadistic. Zero's programming is like [[Stitch]]'s before he abandoned his destructive ways, which is to destroy everything in his path. However, Zero is proven to be too powerful and rebellious to control even for Jumba, which led him to suspend Zero and imprison him on an icy planet. Following his escape, Zero set out his objective to destroy the galaxy. Due to being on the icy planet, Zero didn't know he had [[experiments]] that were created after him, such as meeting Stitch and asking him who he is. However, Zero is remorseless and disregards the notion of family, having refused to listen to Stitch and his values on the subject. This is exemplified when Zero tried to attack Jumba after he was created, as well as when he built an army of robots to destroy the galaxy. When Zero launched his supernova warhead to destroy the galaxy, he didn't even care he would be caught in the explosion as well. Zero is also very confident in his abilities, as he took on the [[Galactic Armada]] with his robot army and even faced off against Stitch himself. However, his confidence borders on overconfidence and arrogance, as well as making him reckless. When Zero destroyed Stitch's spaceship, his ship crashed into Zero's. When Zero launched his supernova warhead, he felt sure that Stitch wasn't going to stop it, and even when he redirected it in a black hole, Zero claimed that Stitch wouldn't survive. However, both of his claims proved wrong, as Stitch not only saved the galaxy, but also escaped the explosion. ===Physical appearance=== Zero's resemblance was close to a purple version of [[Stitch]]. Originally 100% organic, Zero is now a cyborg, part machine, part alien. His organic body is now black while the rest is mostly metal alloys and reinforced plastic. His form resembles a cross between a type of lizard and koala (and robot). He has a two cyborg arms, three spider-like legs, and half-helmet with a cyclonic-like right eye from some unknown incident. In cyborg form, he is missing his nose. ===Powers and abilities=== In his original form, Zero has all the powers of Stitch. In Zero's cyborg form, his cyborg arms serve many purposes, such as cybernetic wiry rope, laser guns, a forked harpoon and welding tool, and his cyborg eye has zoom functions and improves his aim. He can manufacture many weapons, such as android minions, spaceships, and a doomsday device (supernova warhead). ==Appearances== ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== He was the first experiment created before [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] started assigning numbers to his experiments, though Jumba later refers to him as "Experiment Zero" in his eponymous debut. Jumba was attempting to create the ultimate killer monster, and he was successful. However, his success also resulted in him being unable to control the experiment. Eventually, Jumba was forced to suspended Zero's cell activity and imprison him on an icy planet. Zero was eventually able to escape and acquired mechanical body parts, making him even more powerful, and became a ruthless warlord with a cyborg army in the galaxy. When Zero targets Hanpipi Nebula, the [[Grand Councilwoman]] contacts [[Stitch]] to help defeat him. Zero puts up a fight at first, but he was eventually defeated and captured by Stitch. Once restrained, Zero reveals he has a supernova warhead and then initiates its launch toward the Grand Council's headquarters on [[Planet Turo]], threatening the entire galaxy. Stitch was able to redirect the warhead into a black hole forming nearby, saving everyone. It is unknown what happened to Zero and his cyborg army after his defeat. ==Trivia== *Zero is the first experiment to be created by Jumba before he began working with Hämsterviel and numbering his genetic experiments, so he is classified as Experiment 000. He is referred to as "Experiment Zero" instead of "Experiment Zero-Zero-Zero", given that the number is a single digit rather than a whole three-digit. *There is a misconception that Zero is named "Cyber". This moniker was never the experiment's actual name in any official ''[[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|Lilo & Stitch]]'' media. It is likely that fans came up with a unique moniker for him before it was made clear that he was never given a name by [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]]. *Zero is similar to [[Dark End]] but not different from [[627]] and [[Leroy]], as while the latter pair were unable to be rehabilitated, the former pair were never mentioned to be able to be rehabilitated. Regardless, Zero and Dark End most likely would be unable to reform, as Zero proved to be uncontrollable after being created, while Dark End is loyal to [[Delia]]. **Like 627 and Leroy, Zero and Dark End also serve as dark versions of [[Stitch]], with Zero being too difficult to control where he disregarded the notion of family, Dark End having a low opinion on family and friends, and both 627 and Leroy being extremely cruel and destructive monsters that cannot be rehabilitated. 627, Leroy, Zero, and Dark End all serve as what Stitch would have become if he had never met [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and her ''[[Pelekai ʻohana|ʻohana]]'' and been introduced to the meaning of family. *Due to being imprisoned on an icy planet for countless years, Zero didn't know that there were experiments created after him, as he was surprised to see Stitch and asked him who he is. *Zero (in cyborg form), [[Shrink]], and [[Pix]] are the only known experiments whose legs resemble a tripod. *He is one of the few experiments that are actually villains, along with [[Chopsuey]], 627, Leroy and [[Leroy Clones|his clones]], and Dark End, while all the other experiments were following their primary function. ==Gallery== Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero in ship.jpg Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero laughs.jpg Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero hologram.jpg Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero hologram 2.jpg Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero original form.jpg Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero breaks out.jpg Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero imprisoned.jpg Stitch! - Experiment Zero - Zero's description.jpg|[[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] explains his Experiment 000. Flight |paraphernalia = Laser |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Shrink''', also known as '''Experiment 001''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is Jumba's first experiment created with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] and to be assigned a number. He is designed to shrink and/or enlarge objects and individuals. When he was created, Hämsterviel presumably christened him Shrink. After his creation, the press posted stuff about him in the papers, and it is said that the two scientists opened up a joke shop together and began working on Jumba's many other experiments. ==Background== ===Physical appearance=== Shrink is a small purple experiment with a white lower jaw and chest, three tentacle-like legs, two stubby little arms, and two floppy antennae with two rings. He has the ability to levitate in order to move around. ===Powers and abilities=== Shrink can emit a green or pink ray from his eyes that will shrink an object or organism to a very small size. It has also been demonstrated that only the first zap shrinks the object; the second restores its size; and every other enlarges it. He is capable of levitation and/or flight. ===Weaknesses=== Shrink seems to be simple-minded and can easily be manipulated and confused. He can be easily controlled by anyone holding on to his antennae. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 001 was the first genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to change the sizes of objects and individuals. He was apparently named Shrink by Hämsterviel before arriving on Earth. Eventually, 001 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. At an unknown point, Shrink was presumably activated, captured, and rehabilitated by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]]. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== Shrink appeared in a clipping on one of the walls of [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s [[Galaxy Defense Industries|lab]] along with several other pictures of his and [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s early accomplishments. One clip showed a headline of "Idiot Scientist Actually Creates Something!" with Hämsterviel's enlarged bottom in Jumba's face. Despite their past 25 years of partnership, Jumba refused to work for Hämsterviel again when the latter offered, as he had mistreated him and was presumably responsible for Jumba's arrest and imprisonment. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Shrink, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], Jumba, [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. It is unknown whether or not Shrink participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Shrink made an appearance in Season 2 of the ''Stitch!'' anime where he was sent by [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] to mess with [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and shrink [[Stitch]]. He manages to shrink Jumba, Stitch, and [[Tigerlily]]. It is also revealed that Shrink was abandoned at a young age and has a very willful and childlike behavior following an incident of being locked in a safe when he was younger. He shrinks objects using a green ray from his eyes and has the ability to levitate. Shrink reappeared in a later episode, along with [[Squeak]], [[Clip]], [[Nosox]], and [[Retro]]. After Stitch is reverted to his original programming by Retro, he goes on a rampage and ends up falling into a swimming pool along with Shrink's inactive pod. Shrink, seeing that Stitch is drowning, zaps him with his pink ray, causing Stitch to grow larger. Afterwards, Stitch is eventually turned to good again. Jumba arrives and asks why his experiments are running amok and mentions that Shrink may have been confused after being confined in his pod for a long time, before having Shrink restore Stitch back to his original size. Eventually, Shrink was dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in Jumba's vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Shrink wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. Shrink also appeared in the special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Trivia== *Shrink originally debuted in ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''; however, he only appeared as a background character and technically was not seen moving until his appearance in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. *Shrink is one of the ten known experiments named by someone other than Lilo or Stitch, the other nine being [[Gigi]], [[Elastico]], [[Yaarp]], [[Hammerface]], [[Heat]], [[Thresher]], [[Plasmoid]], [[Morpholomew]], and [[Leroy]]. **It is implied that it was Hämsterviel who named him Shrink. **It can also be said that Hämsterviel opened and closed Jumba's career of creating genetic experiments, having named the first and last experiment he funded (Shrink and Leroy, respectively). *Shrink is technically the oldest of all the known experiments, having been the first experiment ever created. *Shrink, [[Zero (Stitch!)|Zero]] (in cyborg form), and [[Pix]] are the only known experiments whose legs resemble a tripod. *Shrink, [[Zap]], [[Remmy]], [[Cloudy]], and [[Welko]] are the only known experiments that are always seen levitating. **[[Phantasmo]] and [[Witch (Lilo & Stitch)|Witch]] primarily levitate but often possess objects or living beings to move by other means. [[Tickle-Tummy]] is also able to levitate, but has been seen bouncing as well. *Shrink is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed. *He is also one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''Leroy & Stitch''. *Shrink's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is red in the ''Stitch!'' anime. *In Shrink's first appearance in the anime, his size ray is green, but in his second appearance, it is pink. *In the English dub of the anime episode "Experiment-A-Palooza", [[Squeak]] mentions that Shrink can shrink and enlarge things, and that both his and Shrink's names are misnomers. ==Gallery== ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== Leroy & Stitch - Clippings of Shrink and Hämsterviel's enlarged bottom in Jumba's face.png 001shrink.jpg Leroy & Stitch - The gang arrives at Aloha Stadium.png ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Shrink circling Jumba.jpg Jumba trying to swat away Shrink.jpg Shrink flying.jpg Jumba and Shrink.jpg Shrink appears.jpg Shrink's eyes glow.jpg Shrink Green Ray.png|Shrink charging up his shrink ray Shrink firing Green Ray.png|Shrink's green ray Jumba being hit by Shrink's shrink ray.png|Shrink hitting [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with his green shrink ray Shrink on a tree.jpg Shrink watching Stitch and Tigerlily.jpg Shrink coming in.jpg Shrink zaps Tigerlily.jpg Shrink falls asleep.jpg Shrink shrunk Tigerlily.jpg Shrink and Stitch.jpg Shrinks zaps Stitch.jpg Shrink flies past Jumba.jpg Tigerlily on Shrink.jpg Tigerlily on Shrink 2.jpg Shrink eyes glow.jpg Shrink zapping again.jpg Shrink and Tigerlily.jpg Shrink taking off.jpg Shrinks flies up.jpg Shrink and Boo Goo.jpg Shrink enlarging BooGoo.jpg Stitch! His appearance is nearly identical to Stitch, except with a rat-like tail, smaller eyes, and no claws. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 002 was the second genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to double-dip food. 002 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. Against statistically unlikely (but not impossible) odds, several experiment pods landed in one location: Mrs. Hasagawa's yard, 002's pod being one of them. At an unknown point, [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] mistook 002's pod for an apricot and washed it, activating the experiment. However, as 002 was not a very evil or destructive experiment, he was able to live a peaceful life with her, due to the latter seeing the former as a mere stray cat who needed a home, though he frequently licked a bowl of hard candies. When [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] discovered that Mrs. Hasagawa, kept several experiments as pets, they thought they were a danger to her and, along with [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]], decided to capture them all. As Mrs. Hasagawa was petting 002, Lilo took the bowl of candy from him and placed it in an open [[Prison Capsule|container]], with the experiment taking the bait. Lilo assured the elderly woman that they would take care of the "problem," though unbeknownst to her, there was no problem to begin with. 002 and the other experiments were about to be taken away, but were returned them to Mrs. Hasagawa when Lilo and Stitch saw how much she cared for them. 002 was then named Doubledip. ===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''=== Doubledip was one of the experiments that was gliding on the screen, but he is 608 instead of 002. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Doubledip, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Doubledip participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Doubledip made a special guest appearance (along with [[Sparky (Lilo & Stitch)|Sparky]], [[Felix (Lilo & Stitch)|Felix]], and [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]]) in the ''Stitch!'' segment "[[w:c:liloandstitch:Kung Fu Dragon Pleak Lee|Kung Fu Dragon Pleak Lee]]". ==Trivia== *His name and number are a likely reference to the fact that he engages in double-dipping. *Doubledip, [[Experiments#4-Series: Top secret and mysterious series of militaristic and mostly failed experiments|Char]], [[Experiments#4-Series: Top secret and mysterious series of militaristic and mostly failed experiments|Crusty]], and [[Experiments#4-Series: Top secret and mysterious series of militaristic and mostly failed experiments|Botulator]] are the only known experiments whose functions are related to spoiling food. *Doubledip was activated off-screen. *Doubledip somehow changed in size in ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. *Doubledip is one of five experiments whose appearance resembles Stitch, the others being [[Zero (Stitch!)|Zero]], [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]], [[627]], and [[Leroy]]. ==Gallery== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== L&S - [[Experiments]] ("cousins") |owner = [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]}} '''Gigi''', also known as '''Experiment 007''' and '''Yapper''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. She is designed to sit, lie down, fetch, and annoy Jumba's neighbors with her shrill bark. Her one true place is with [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] as her pet. ==Background== ===Personality=== While Gigi fulfills the purpose she was programmed for, which was to annoy individuals with her constant barking, this is not a defining feature or quality of herself. Most of the time, she is well-behaved and appears to look and act like a normal dog: barking, fetching, and listening to orders. She can be distinguished from a real dog by her ability to talk. She is quite affectionate to those she likes, licking Mertle's face and complimenting [[Clip]] on cutting a [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clone]]'s fur off. She is also loyal and brave, pushing Mertle out of the way of a plasma blast. She holds the ideal of family and [[Pelekai ʻohana|''ʻohana'']] very close and always thinks of Mertle too having convinced her (albeit somewhat reluctantly) to join [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s ''ʻohana'' picture because she wanted to be in it as well, and seems to get along well with her cousins. ===Physical appearance=== Gigi is a quadrupedal, white Shih Tzu-like experiment with a purple bow, solid black eyes, and a little black nose. Jumba, however, mentions that she is hard to recognize after "so many groomings and much ribbons," implying that her natural appearance is somewhat different, which may also explain why she looks less alien-like than most of the other known experiments. ===Powers and abilities=== Gigi has an annoying shrill bark and the typical abilities of a common dog, such as sitting, fetching, and licking her owner's face. She can also speak fluently very well as seen in ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 007 was the seventh genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. She was designed to behave like a typical "good dog" and annoy Jumba's neighbors with her constant yapping. 007 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. At an unknown point, Experiment 007 was activated and then later adopted by [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], who named her Gigi. In "[[Yapper]]", Mertle showed Gigi off to [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]], and then revealed that she was entering her in a dog show contest in [[Honolulu]]. However, when Gigi's loud, shrill yapping began to annoy Stitch, the latter swallowed her whole. Mertle screamed in horror until Lilo pulled Gigi out of Stitch's stomach and gave her back. Enraged, Mertle called Lilo and Stitch "riffraff" and took Gigi, now covered in slobber, to a pet salon to get her cleaned up. Believing she could win Mertle's friendship by beating her Gigi, Lilo traveled via limousine to Honolulu with Stitch, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], and [[Pleakley]]. There, she entered Stitch in the same dog show, claiming he was a rare "blue-furred ectoplasmic detection dog" to impress [[Mitzi Suzuki and Kato Stewart|the judges]]. After engaging in an unfriendly rivalry, Lilo and Mertle entered Stitch and Gigi into all the competitions, and the contest took place the next day. However, both Stitch's temper (when he fought with a contestant's dog after the latter sniffed him) and overconfidence caused him to lose the first two rounds. In the final competition, Mertle secretly gave Stitch extra strong coffee to make the latter go crazy so that Gigi would win. Mertle's plan was successful at first until [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] suddenly burst into the arena searching for her "dog". Stitch impulsively attacked Gantu, who fired his [[Plasma Blaster|plasma gun]] uncontrollably, but a stray plasma blast caused the ceiling to collapse on top of Stitch. Gantu then took Gigi from a terrified Mertle, after which she complained to Lilo. Because Gigi was Stitch's cousin, Lilo promised to save her from Gantu. She then gave Stitch more coffee intentionally, thus enabling the latter to defeat Gantu and get Gigi back safe and sound. Grateful but indignant, Mertle gave the "Best in Show" trophy to Lilo. However, when Lilo saw how much Mertle truly cared for Gigi, the former decided to leave Gigi with Mertle. Gigi reappeared in "[[Amnesio (episode)|Amnesio]]", being accompanied by Mertle and [[Elena, Teresa, and Yuki|the hula girls]] while Lilo attempted to invite them to her birthday party. In "[[PJ (episode)|PJ]]", Gigi and a couple of regular dogs attacked Lilo's substitute teacher wearing squeaky shoes shaped like dog biscuits, which was one of [[PJ (Lilo & Stitch)|PJ]]'s many pranks. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== Gigi was seen being walked by [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], the latter stopping to taunt [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] before moving on. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Gigi along with Mertle, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. During the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], Mertle was seen running with Gigi in her arms, trying to avoid attacking Leroys. When Mertle and Gigi were both saved from a Leroy clone by [[Clip]], Gigi revealed her ability to speak (surprising Mertle) and her status as an experiment, then pushed Mertle out of the way of another Leroy clone's plasma blast. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. Following the battle, Gigi declared that she wanted to be part of Lilo's ''[[Pelekai ʻohana|ʻohana]]'' photo, convincing Mertle to join it with her. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Gigi was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'' in the experiment gallery. *Gigi was activated off-screen. *Gigi, along with [[Dorkifier]], [[Nosox]], [[Experiments#2-Series: Technological and scientific|Butter]], [[Shortstuff]], [[Spike (Lilo & Stitch)|Spike]], [[Yang]], [[Richter]], [[Phoon]], [[Tank (Lilo & Stitch)|Tank]], [[Splodyhead]], and one [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Leroy & Stitch|unconfirmed experiment]], are the only known experiments that are primarily quadrupeds. *Gigi is one of the ten known experiments named by someone other than Lilo or Stitch, the other nine being [[Elastico]], [[Yaarp]], [[Hammerface]], [[Heat]], [[Thresher]], [[Plasmoid]], [[Morpholomew]], [[Shrink]], and [[Leroy]]. **Gigi, in particular, was named by Mertle. **Lilo did give a name for 007, namely "Yapper". However, since 007's one true place is being Mertle's "dog", Lilo has accepted her true name as "Gigi", the name Mertle gave her. **Her episode is named "[[Yapper]]" after the nickname Lilo gave her, but "Gigi", the name Mertle gave her, is her official name on the experiments list in the end credits of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. *She is also one of the six known experiments to be rehabilitated by someone other than Lilo and Stitch, the other five being Elastico, Yaarp, Spike, [[Frenchfry]], and [[Snooty]]. **Gigi, in particular, was rehabilitated by Mertle. *Her number is a reference to the code number of the legendary {{WikipediaLink|James Bond (literary character)|James Bond}}. This could very well be a coincidence, though Gigi does share one similarity with James Bond: she is an alien undercover as a dog. *Gigi's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] appeared among a bunch of other blue pods on [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]'s [[Gantu's Ship|messy ship]] in the episode "[[627 (episode)|627]]". *Gigi never spoke in ''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''. However, during the climax of ''Leroy & Stitch'', it is revealed that she can speak fluently very well and says to [[Clip]], "Nice one, cousin," after seeing Clip cut a [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clone]]'s fur off. She then says to Mertle, "Look out!" and pushes her out of the way of another Leroy clone's plasma blast. *Mertle adopting Gigi at the [[Aloha Animal Rescue|animal shelter]] mirrors the relationship between Lilo and Stitch, as Mertle didn't know Gigi was a genetic experiment until she found out in ''Leroy & Stitch''. *In some recent book releases, like ''Manners Matter, Stitch'' and ''Stitch Goes to School'', Gigi is replaced by a poodle named Cashmere.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kInI3WULCJE YouTube - Read-Aloud: Manners Matter, Stitch][https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=phwmbCSoK2o YouTube - Stitch Goes to School - Children's Book Read Aloud] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{L&S|Gigi (007)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Pets]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Heroines]] [[Category:Neutral characters]]

[[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Pop''', also known as '''Experiment 009''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to use his tail to blow up a balloon to the size of the room he is in, then popping the balloon, discombobulating those involved near the explosion of the balloon and causing frizzy hair. He appears in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. ==Background== Experiment 009 was the ninth genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel's]] funding. He was designed to discombobulate and disorient enemies by using his tail to blow up and pop balloons. 009 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. ===Physical appearance=== Pop is a small, orange and caramel-colored monkey-like experiment with two pink orbs on the top of his head with three stubby multi-colored antennae. Pop has a white face and stomach and a small red nose, as well as green markings on his rear and back. Pop's tail is a pump which he uses to blow up pink balloons which reform on his tail after they pop. ===Powers and abilities=== Pop can use his tail to blow up a balloon to the size of the room he is in, then popping the balloon, discombobulating those involved near the explosion of the balloon and causing frizzy hair. ==Appearances== ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== In "Stitch's Birthday, Part Two", Pop was displayed by a young [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] to [[Delia]] approximately around the time of [[Stitch|Experiment 626's]] creation, accidentally letting Pop out of his [[Prison Capsule|containment capsule]]. Naturally, he carried out his primary function, inflating his tail in front of an interested Delia. Hämsterviel jumps on the enlarging balloon, but is propelled with the balloon. Delia soon realizes what is happening, and as she tries to escape, the balloon gets too big and immobilizes her, pressing her against Hämsterviel. The balloon eventually pops, yet Pop's fate afterwards is unknown, although he somehow ended back with [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]. ==Trivia== *With only one brief animated scene, Pop most likely has the least amount of screen time out of all the fully confirmed experiments that appeared in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. ==Gallery== Hämsterviel carrying Pop.png Pop on Hämsterviel's back.png Pop slides out.png Pop on the floor.png Pop turns around.png Pop jumps up.png Pop sticks the landing.png Pop in Stitch!.jpg Pop shaking his tail.png Pop's tail balloon inflating.png Hämsterviel on Pop's balloon.jpg Pop's balloon still inflating.jpg Pop's balloon about to blow.jpg Pop covering his ears.jpg Pop next to Hämsterviel.png Delia really mad at Hämsterviel.png Stitch Alien Experiment Character Guide - Pop and Felix.jpg ==External links== *{{L&S|Pop (009)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]]

Dirt bursts (temporarily) |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} {{Quote|Dirty!|Felix|Felix (episode)}} '''Felix''', also known as '''Experiment 010''' (and temporarily '''Oscar'''), is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to clean and sterilize everything in sight, but had a flaw in his programming that caused him to be unable to tell the difference between dirt and living things. Thus, he saw all living beings as giant, filthy germs needing to be sterilized until Jumba temporarily reprogrammed him into a dirt freak. He was captured by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], but was rescued in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]". Although his "one true place" was never depicted in ''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]'', he was eventually given one in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, with him becoming a mobile recycling service. ==Background== ===Personality=== Felix was originally obsessed with cleanliness to the point that he considered even individuals germs that must be "sterilized" at all costs. It is also shown that Felix has a defect that kicks in when he is faced with anything aged or antique because he doesn't understand the concept of antiques, and as far as he knows, they only collect dust. During Felix's reprogramming, he became obsessed with dirt. The only word that 010 can say is "Dirty!" However, as Felix, he says it disgustedly, while when reprogrammed to Oscar, he exclaims it happily. In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, however, where he only appears in his Felix persona, it is generalized to being the only word he says without any tonal consistency; although in one episode of the anime, when he and [[Sparky (Lilo & Stitch)|Sparky]] inform [[Stitch]] about [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s dinosaur robot going on a rampage, Felix exclaims, "''E. rex''!" This remains the only instance to date that he says anything other than "dirty". Jumba appears to have found the right balance in Felix's programming. Felix is currently obsessed with cleanliness instead of only dirt, respecting antiques and recycling when appropriate. According to Jumba in the anime, Felix only sleeps when his stomach is full. ===Physical appearance=== Felix is a small, green-furred experiment resembling both an elephant and an anteater. He has a small body, a thin long tail with a brushy fuzz at the end, a large head with a long tubular elephant/vacuum-like trunk, large black eyes, small short ears, four fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot (all ending in black claws) and three dark-tipped antennae arranged in a crest-like structure. ===Powers and abilities=== Felix can suck up objects and dust using his anteater-like trunk/snout, sweep with his tail, and spin himself into a tornado to clean. He can also shoot lasers out of his snout, which is used to disintegrate germs and small creatures. After his reprogramming, he could release the sucked-up dirt in massive bursts. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 010 was the tenth genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to keep Jumba's house clean and tidy, but due to a glitch in his program, he viewed all organisms (including individuals) as germs that must be "sterilized" at all costs, and threw away anything even remotely dirty. 010 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. Experiment 010 was activated off-screen and captured by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] at some point. Due to 010's tendency to throw out anything that was even remotely filthy (including prized belongings), Gantu sent 010 to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]], but he found 010 annoying as well, and thus sent him back to Gantu, who abandoned 010. Left with nothing else to do, 010 started cleaning up [[Lahui Beach|the beach]] until he was discovered by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]], who captured him in a picnic basket and took him [[Lilo's House|home]]. Later, Lilo brought 010, named Felix, to her [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]], where he tidied up the auditorium, but due to a mishap with [[Moses Puloki|Moses]]' oriental rug, Felix was taken back to the Pelekais' house. Although Lilo and Stitch had become less impressed by the neat freak, Felix's cleanliness proved to be very useful at home, which fascinated [[Pleakley]] to the point that he befriended the cleaning experiment. However, he then started destroying and throwing out Lilo, Stitch, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], and Pleakley's personal belongings. Eventually, Felix decided to "antisepticize" Lilo's ''[[Pelekai ʻohana|ʻohana]]'' as well and, locking them inside the house (save Pleakley, whom Felix locked outside), relentlessly pursued them until they were able to trap him in a [[Prison Capsule|container]]. Jumba then reprogrammed Felix to be less of a neat freak, but instead of just liking dirt, it caused Felix to begin making things incredibly dirty. Lilo and Stitch later sent Felix (renamed Oscar) back to Gantu as a present, but due to the experiment's new programming, rather than help Gantu clean up [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]] like the latter hoped, Felix made it even dirtier. It can be presumed that Gantu sent Felix back to Hämsterviel after this messy incident. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Felix was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. In "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", Felix was sent back to Gantu along with all of Hämsterviel's other captive experiments after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused chaos and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. Felix reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by Lilo, Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission. ===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''=== Felix was one of the experiments that were gliding on the screen, but he is identified as 602 instead of 010. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Felix, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. It is unknown whether or not Felix participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Felix first appeared in his own episode in the ''Stitch!'' anime where [[Stitch]] summoned him so he could get out of cleaning the house. It is shown in this episode that Felix has a defect that kicks in when he is faced with anything aged or antique. However, Felix apparently doesn't understand the concept of antiques, and as far as he knows, they only collect dust. Thus, his programming causes him to terminate anything aged in order to prevent the buildup of dust. In the end, he is reprogrammed to collect things that can be renewed and recycles them. His one true place after this is as a mobile recycling service. In the two-part Season 1 finale "Stitch vs. Hämsterviel", [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] puts Felix along with [[Sparky (Lilo & Stitch)|Sparky]] and [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]] under his control. He also appeared in "Dracula Jr.". ==[[Disney Experiences|Disney Parks]]== ===[[Tokyo Disneyland]]=== Felix premiered at Tokyo Disneyland in [[2006]] during the "Find Stitch" event in "Lilo & Stitch's Huli Huli Ohana Bash". He also made an appearance in the [[2009]] show "Dreams Within". ===[[Disneyland Paris]]=== Felix appeared at Disneyland Paris in [[2011]] for Stitch's Hawaiian Paradise Party. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink|Felix}} ==Trivia== *Both of 010's names and personalities are references to the main characters of the [[1970]] [[ABC]] sitcom ''{{WikipediaLink|The Odd Couple (1970 TV series)|The Odd Couple}}''. *Felix was activated off-screen. *Felix, [[Phoon]], [[Blowhard]], and one [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Leroy & Stitch|unconfirmed experiment]] are the only known experiments that have trunks similar to elephants and tapirs. *Felix appears, along with several other ''[[Lilo & Stitch]]'' characters, in a [[We're All in This Together|parody]] of the [[Disney Channel]] [[Disney Channel Original Movie|Original Movie]] ''[[High School Musical]]'', which was broadcast as part of the ''High School Musical: Around the World'' one-year anniversary special. *Felix's antennae appear in the online game ''[[Jumba's Lab]]''. ==External links== *{{L&S|Felix (010)|Felix}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Felix}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Neutral characters]] [[Category:Custodians]] [[Category:Elephants]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Characters in Disney parks]] [[Category:Characters in video games]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]]

Salesperson |home = [[Hawaii]] |likes = Selling stuff, satisfied customers |dislikes = Dissatisfaction, being captured |powers = Expert seller |paraphernalia = Cane |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Slick''', also known as '''Experiment 020''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to sell anything to anyone like an expert by using his sales pitch and auctioneer-like stratagems. However, once he starts selling, he is programmed to do it nonstop. His one true place is selling for charity and fundraisers at [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]]. ==Background== ===Personality=== Slick is a fast-talking, Southern-accented salesman. He is generally very friendly and polite, tipping his hat every time he greets somebody, but is quite obsessive about selling stuff. He won't stop doing so until there is nothing left to sell, even selling himself to [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] through a live auction. He is also very kind-hearted and courteous, and strongly supports his one true place in working for charity. Despite being incredibly friendly, Slick can also be amazingly fierce. This was shown during the climactic battle in ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. His initial facial expression after [[Stitch]]'s pep talk was fearsome, and at one point during the battle, he had a [[Leroy]] [[Leroy Clones|clone]] running from him. Thus, he can easily turn from a friendly salesperson to a terrifying fighter, while still keeping his good intentions. ===Physical appearance=== Slick is a fast-talking, pink humanoid doglike experiment resembling [[Cannonball]], but with a smaller face, a purple nose, and two ebony-black eyes, with hair-like antennae on top of his head. He wears a straw boater hat and bowtie and carries a cane. ===Powers and abilities=== Slick is charismatic and persuasive, as he can sell anything to anyone, even if they have no reason or wouldn't buy it otherwise, by using sympathy and slight exaggeration effects. He can speak fluently and is capable of controlling his facial emotions and voice to persuade customers, and has quick auctioneer-like speaking qualities. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 020 was the twentieth genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to sell anything to anyone until there was nothing available for sale. According to Jumba, 020 once sold his [[Galaxy Defense Industries|laboratory]] instead of other experiments, and another time he sold Jumba's ex-wife for the outrageous price of ten kiltacredits, when she was only worth five. 020 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. At an unknown point after this, Experiment 020 was activated. While [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] were having trouble selling candy bars for a fundraiser at their [[Kaiāulu Hale|school]], they encountered 020 sitting on a park bench reading a newspaper. When 020 heard about Lilo and Stitch's soliciting problem, he introduced himself to them and then presented his card revealing his number and primary function. Afterwards, 020, named Slick, offered to assist Lilo and Stitch in their fundraising drive. Using his sales pitch, Slick managed to convince every person whom Lilo came across into buying one of her chocolate bars. However, Slick later grew obsessive and began selling everything the Pelekais owned. Since they were unable to capture Slick (as he had sold all their [[Prison Capsule|containment orbs]] as well), Lilo left [[Pleakley]] in charge of Slick while she and Stitch both set out to redeem all of their personal belongings. Among one of them was a trophy that [[Charles and Mary|a couple]] was using to stabilize an outdoor dining table. While they were doing this, [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], who had learned about Slick earlier, arrived at the [[Lilo's House|Pelekais' house]] looking for the salesman experiment. Annoyed, Pleakley tried to get Mertle to leave, but Slick, advising him not to turn away a customer, let her come in. When the two debated over custody of Slick, the latter held an impromptu auction and set the opening bid at one dollar. It ended with Slick selling himself to Mertle for three dollars. After managing to retrieve all of their household possessions, Lilo and Stitch returned home and put everything back in its proper place, then discovered that Slick was missing. Pleakley explained what happened, prompting Lilo and Stitch to get Slick back. Meanwhile, Mertle used Slick to sell candy bars and help her win the contest until Lilo and Stitch stole him, but Mertle managed to steal him back. Later, when Lilo and Stitch (disguised as beekeepers) went over to [[Mertle's House|Mertle's house]] to reclaim Slick, she revealed that she had sold him to [[Reuben|Experiment 625]], much to their horror. At [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]], Slick acquainted himself with Reuben and later sold the ship to an elderly man, who had somehow gained entry. Slick was soon captured in a container by an ailing [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], who had been repeatedly persuaded by [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] to do so. Fortunately, Lilo and Stitch showed up and were able to free Slick, but he then escaped while also selling the batteries in Gantu's [[Plasma Blaster|blaster]] to a pair of locals. Gantu later tracked Slick down and recaptured him. However, the former ultimately bartered Slick for Lilo's last chocolate bar, claiming it would cure his cold. Shortly after, Slick found his one true place at Lilo's school in raising money for charity. In "[[Ploot (episode)|Ploot]]", Lilo tried to convince Slick to help her defeat [[Ploot]], but he led Lilo astray by trying to get her to buy a [[Kokaua Town]] umbrella. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Slick was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. ===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''=== Slick was one of the experiments that were gliding on the screen, but he is 597 instead of 020. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Slick, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Slick participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], having frightened at least one Leroy clone. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Slick made a special guest appearance in the ''Stitch!'' segment "[[w:c:liloandstitch:Kung Fu Dragon Pleak Lee|Kung Fu Dragon Pleak Lee]]". ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Slick is one of the only four known experiments that wears a hat, the other three being [[Frenchfry]], [[Squeak]], and [[Derrick]]. He is designed to restrain and immobilize the target's movement with projectile donuts. First he asks, "Ever had a Hertz Donut?" He then fires energy which solidifies into a donut that constricts around the target and says, "Hurts, don't it?" He appears in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. ==Background== Experiment 022 was the 22nd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He is designed to give off a brilliant light with which to pose as an invasion-signaling beacon to the [[Galactic Armada]]. His one true place is as a Christmas star. ==Background== ===Physical appearance=== Topper is a small yellow-orange star-shaped creature with a little white-tipped antenna on his head, small dark blue eyes, a thin mouth, white-tipped limbs, and a white marking on his belly. ===Powers and abilities=== Topper can produce a brilliant light visible even from space that helps alien fleets locate him. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 025 was the 25th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel's]] funding. He was designed to use his bright light to pose as a beacon for an invasion to the [[Galactic Armada]]. 025 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 025's pod was found by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] on Christmas Eve, which he planned on having it gift-wrapped and sent out to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] as a Christmas present after [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] suggested this to Gantu beforehand. Meanwhile, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] was attempting to teach a naive [[Stitch]] about Christmas and all the traditions associated with the holiday, when the latter soon noticed a woman putting 025's pod in a gift box. Stitch hastily grabbed what he thought was the gift-wrapped pod, but when he tried to tell Lilo, she ignored him. When Gantu later dropped by to pick up 025's pod, the same woman who had gift-wrapped it earlier hinted that there was a mishap involving Stitch, much to Gantu's anger. He then swore to avenge Stitch for stealing Hämsterviel's Christmas gift. In an attempt to find the pod, Stitch stole countless presents from every house and the local mall on Kauai. Lilo assumed Stitch was selfishly hoarding Christmas gifts for himself, but after the latter was [[Prison Capsule|captured]] and interrogated by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], Stitch revealed what he was really trying to do. Shortly after, Gantu attacked the [[Lilo's House|Pelekai residence]] and managed to make off with all the stolen presents. Lilo and Stitch clashed with Reuben on [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]] and forced him to reveal the location of the experiment pod. After they pinpointed the pod in [[Kokaua Town|town]], Lilo and Stitch tussled with Gantu dressed in a [[Santa Claus|Santa]] outfit, as did Jumba and [[Pleakley]]. Stitch snatched the gift-wrapped pod from Gantu, although he retrieved it after a long chase. When he then attempted to crush Lilo for meddling, she reprimanded Gantu until he admitted that he intended to give 025's pod to Hämsterviel as a Christmas present. Just then, a little girl asked Gantu for a mere Christmas gift, believing he was actually Santa. Forced to comply, Gantu ended up giving 025's pod to her and later distributed presents to other children, thereby honoring the true spirit of Christmas. After Jumba discovered 025 to be harmless, Lilo activated 025 in a fountain. She then named him Topper, shared him with the little girl seen previously, and gave him a one true place atop the local Christmas tree (actually a decorated Pleakley) as a Christmas star, while Topper's bright light unintentionally signaled the [[Galactic Armada]]. Topper reappeared in "[[Elastico (episode)|Elastico]]" as one of the audience members for Lilo's hula dance. ===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''=== Topper was one of the experiments that was gliding on the screen, but he is 591 instead of 025. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Topper, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Topper participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], but it is unknown what he did. However, it is presumed that he wouldn't have been able to be very effective, due to the fact that his powers are deemed useless. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Topper made a cameo appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime as one of the experiments in [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison cell]]. ==Trivia== *Topper was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'' in the experiment gallery. *Topper is one of the rare experiments to not have black eyes like most experiments, having blue eyes instead. *Topper's primary function is to use his bright light to signal the alien attack fleet. However, on the Disney site, it is incorrectly stated that Topper's light is designed to keep people awake. *Even though Topper found his one true place atop a Christmas tree, it is unknown what he does during the other seasons. **It is possible that he stays with the little girl whom he was given to for the rest of the year. *Topper's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is white. *His number is a likely reference to Christmas Day ([[December 25]]). ==Gallery== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== L&S - 1x21 - Topper - Woman holding Topper's experiment pod about to be gift-wrapped.png|Topper's experiment pod vlcsnap-2013-07-21-08h02m50s39.png vlcsnap-2013-07-21-08h12m20s186.png L&S - 1x21 - Topper.png Vlcsnap-2013-05-23-17h29m25s21.png vlcsnap-2013-07-21-08h16m03s102.png vlcsnap-2013-06-13-22h43m35s209.png|Topper laughing vlcsnap-2013-06-13-22h44m05s251.png L&S - 1x17 - Elastico - Experiments cheering Lilo.jpg ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== Leroy & Stitch - Experiments at Aloha Stadium.png Leroy & Stitch - 'I wonder what they got in store for us?'.png Leroy & Stitch - Hämsterviel about to fall off ship.png Leroy & Stitch - Hämsterviel falls as the experiments watch in horror.png Leroy & Stitch - GACC ship arriving at Aloha Stadium.png Leroy & Stitch - Stitch giving his cousins a pep talk.png Leroy & Stitch - Stitch leading his cousins into battle.png Leroy & Stitch - Stitch's cousins following into battle.png Leroy & Stitch - The Experiments group shot.jpg Leroy & Stitch - The Experiments group photo.png Leroy & Stitch - Lilo's scrapbook showing photos of experiments in their one true place.png ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== ScreenCapture 26.02.13 19-44-43.jpg screenCapture 05.03.13 21-22-39.jpg screenCapture 05.03.13 21-23-46.jpg ==Miscellaneous== Topper (Experiment 025).png Groupphoto.jpg Club Buena Vista - Stitch! He is designed to give his wearer the power of command over all living creatures, with the exception of experiments created after him, as well as the blind and nearsighted; his hypnotic effects vanish instantly as soon as he leaves his wearer's head. ==Background== ===Personality=== Checkers hasn't shown much emotion or individuality, other than once while running from [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]. He mostly attaches himself to an individual and stays there, almost as if he were an inanimate object. ===Physical appearance=== Checkers is a yellow-and-purple crown-shaped, centipede-like experiment with black eyes, a dark pink nose, and four pairs of legs that sits curled up like a crown on individuals' heads. ===Powers and abilities=== Checkers can hypnotize those around his current wearer to worship the aforesaid wearer like royalty. His eyes flash purple when causing the hypnosis, and his effects are undone as soon as he leaves his wearer's head. ===Weaknesses=== Other experiments created after Checkers are immune to his hypnotic effect. Individuals that are rendered blind or have nearsighted vision are also immune to Checkers' hypnosis. In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, Checkers will fall/leap off his host if he eats intolerably spicy foods. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 029 was the 29th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to make his wearer a king or queen by hypnotizing those around them to worship them as royalty. 029 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch |Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. Experiment 029 was activated off-screen and then chased throughout [[Kokaua Town]] by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], who had been informed about the experiment, but not before making a vain attempt to kill [[Reuben|Experiment 625]]'s pet cockroach named [[Jimmy the Cockroach|Jimmy]]. 029 was eventually rescued by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] and taken [[Lilo's House|home]]. After Lilo discovered 029's powers, the former named him Checkers and donned him, thus becoming a queen. She then started making silly decrees and bossed [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] and other individuals around, even [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]. She also made [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] and [[Elena, Teresa, and Yuki|the hula girls]] her bodyguards. Before long, Mertle and the hula girls arrested many "troublemakers" for defying their queen (including [[Pleakley]]), so Lilo decided to step down by removing Checkers. However, before she could figure out his one true place, Gantu arrived and grabbed Checkers. After putting the latter on his head, thus becoming a king, Gantu made his victims his servants. Fortunately, Stitch and Reuben were immune to Checkers' hypnotic effect, and both cousins rallied an army of other experiments that attacked Gantu and were able to remove Checkers from his head, overthrowing him. As a result, Gantu's ex-servants revolted against him. After the rebellion, Lilo thought about Checkers' one true place, though it was never revealed. Later, Checkers and the other experiments, along with Jumba and Pleakley, watched Nani as she participated in the Coconut Queen Festival parade (since the original Coconut Queen called in sick) by riding atop a parade float that Lilo, the hula girls, and Stitch's cousins had modified sometime earlier. ===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''=== Checkers was one of the experiments that were gliding on the screen, but he is 553 instead of 029. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Checkers, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Checkers participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], but it is unknown what he did. However, it is presumed that he wouldn't have been able to be very effective, due to the fact that his powers are deemed useless. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Checkers has appeared on multiple occasions in the ''Stitch!'' anime. It is also revealed that he will jump off of his host if he eats intolerably spicy foods. He premiered in "Princess Penny", where [[Reuben]] used Checkers to temporarily rule over [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] and [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] before taking him on a shopping trip and then asking [[Stitch]] and [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] to watch him while Reuben bought some supplies. Also, when Checkers was being worn on the head of [[Penny (Stitch!)|Penny]], he ate some of her spicy sandwich and a hot pepper, causing him to leap off his host. Checkers reappeared in "King Meega!", intended to be used by Hämsterviel to command the inhabitants to capture Stitch, but had escaped on his own to Yuna's school, where everyone intended to use his powers for themselves. Stitch once captured Checkers and wore him on his head, but his hypnotic powers did not work on anyone else. [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] recalls that Checkers' powers do not work on Stitch, as he himself is immune to Checkers' effects. (This actually contradicts what happened in "Princess Penny", as Reuben had used Checkers himself without any problems.) Checkers also appeared in the special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Checkers was activated off-screen. *Checkers is one of the few known experiments whose powers Lilo falls victim to. *The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Checkers as: "Experiment 029. Primary function: King maker. Gives his wearer power of command over all living creatures." *Checkers is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed. *In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, Checkers has a tendency to say "Check!" repeatedly when he moves. *Although [[Dave Wittenberg]] voices Checkers in the English dub of both of the experiment's anime episodes, he is only credited in "Princess Penny" and isn't credited in "King Meega!" for unknown reasons. **Also, [[Reuben]] was able to use Checkers' hypnotic powers in "Princess Penny" without any problems, which contradicts "King Meega!" in terms of Checkers' powers having no effect on experiments that were created after him. ==External links== *{{L&S|Checkers (029)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Neutral characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]]

[[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Fibber''', also known as '''Experiment 032''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to detect lies; the more individuals lie, the more he buzzes, forcing entire populations to tell the truth. He was captured by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], but was rescued in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]". ==Background== ===Personality=== Fibber appears to be mute (except when buzzing at a lie) and sometimes blank, but he has displayed emotion on a few occasions. For example, in "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]", when [[Pleakley]] came out wearing a makeshift suit of armor (to protect himself from [[Spike (Lilo & Stitch)|Spike]]'s spines), Fibber heavily frowned in bewilderment. However, when Pleakley managed to convince the other experiments in his E.A.R.W.A.X. group to attempt hugging therapy on each other, Fibber ended up shedding tears and "aww"-ing at the sight of Pleakley hugging Spike. His "aww" is the only time he made a verbal sound other than beeping (although this was drowned out by the other experiments around him also "aww"-ing). ===Physical appearance=== Fibber is a small orange experiment with small body, arms and legs, a very large head with a dark orange marking on the forehead that glows bright yellow whenever he beeps, little antennae, a little mouth with a purple tongue, a round crimson nose, black-blue eyes, and four ears. ===Powers and abilities=== Whenever Fibber hears a lie, he responds by emitting a loud buzzing sound and lights up the pattern on his forehead. The bigger the lie, the louder he beeps, and the brighter his marking glows. He also appears to possess some level of super strength despite his diminutive size, as he was able to toss a washing machine off of himself after it was placed on him to muffle his beeping. It should be noted that truths and lies are a matter of perspective, as in what one believes to be true or false. Thus, it can be assumed that if an individual spoke of something that they believed to be true (but is actually false), Fibber will most likely not react, since the "truth" is ''believed'' to be true by the individual who spoke it. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 032 was the 32nd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to use his lie-detecting ability to force entire civilizations to only ever tell the truth. Based on Jumba's incorrect theory, this would result in a societal collapse. 032 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. At an unknown point after this, Experiment 032 was activated. An estimated twelve hours after his activation, 032 was [[Prison Capsule|captured]] by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] and taken back to their [[Lilo's House|house]]. The former then tried to look up 032 on [[Jumba's Computer|Jumba's computer]]. When [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] himself revealed which experiment it was, Lilo claimed she knew all along, causing 032 to buzz loudly in reply. He buzzed again when Lilo lied to [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] about cleaning her room, making Stitch openly laugh at Lilo's dishonesty. That night, while Stitch was forced to share his bed with 032, named Fibber, [[Pleakley]] received a call from [[Mrs. Pleakley|his mother]]. She had been badgering her son about finding a soul mate, and even revealed that she'd found him a perfect bride on [[Plorgonar]] and made plans to bring him home to be married. Pleakley felt heartbroken, not wanting to leave his ''[[Pelekai ʻohana|ʻohana]]'' forever, until Lilo and Jumba convinced him to lie his way out. So Pleakley called his mother back and fabricated his sham engagement, while Fibber kept buzzing. Shortly after, Pleakley's relatives arrived at the Pelekais' house to witness his proposal to Nani, while the latter reluctantly posed as Pleakley's fiancée after Lilo forced her. Pleakley's charade led to a fake wedding that Nani turned down (Jumba later took her place by dressing up as a bride). Meanwhile, Lilo and Stitch attempted to hide Fibber in all sorts of places to drown out his frequent buzzing caused by Pleakley lying to his family. When [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] returned from a spa weekend, he discovered Fibber's recent activation, which [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] deliberately neglected to notify him about. Gantu later crashed the phony ceremony to try and take Fibber but was foiled by Lilo and Stitch, although Gantu managed to divulge the experiment's lie-detecting nature in the process. Pleakley eventually told his relatives the truth, and while Fibber buzzed at the false comments they made about Pleakley, they were able to accept the fact that he was happy living on Earth and didn't want to get married. However, as Pleakley's family prepared to depart, Gantu reappeared in his [[Manta Shuttle|shuttle]] and captured Fibber. Regardless, Lilo decided to let Fibber stay with Gantu for now. Back at [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]], Fibber buzzed when Gantu lied to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] about his whereabouts, while Reuben befriended the lie-detecting experiment. In "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]", Fibber was one of the experiments in Pleakley's E.A.R.W.A.X. group. He buzzed during the therapy session whenever one of the other experiments lied (mainly [[Bonnie (Lilo & Stitch)|Bonnie]], when she lied about her being intelligent and falsely accused [[Clyde (Lilo & Stitch)|Clyde]] of their arrest). Earlier, Fibber buzzed when Pleakley denied that his antenna was prematurely orange and simply dyed green (as stated by [[Nosy]]). When the other experiments later began to cause chaos, Fibber watched nonchalantly while smiling. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Fibber was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. In "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", Fibber was sent back to Gantu along with all of Hämsterviel's other captive experiments after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused chaos and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. Fibber reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by Lilo, Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission. ===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''=== Fibber was one of the experiments that were gliding on the screen, but he is 580 instead of 032. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Fibber, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Fibber did not participate in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], instead choosing to retreat with the weaker experiments. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe, during which Fibber can be seen around some of the Leroys as they started to shut down. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Fibber was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'' in the experiment gallery. *Fibber was activated off-screen. *In [[Fibber (episode)|his debut]], it is revealed that Fibber likes cookies, as he was seen raiding the cookie jar at one point. *In "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]", Fibber was seen at Pleakley's E.A.R.W.A.X. group, but Gantu captured him. **However, this episode was confirmed by [[Jess Winfield]] to take place chronologically after "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", considering the fact that [[Nosy]], [[Bonnie (Lilo & Stitch)|Bonnie]], and [[Clyde (Lilo & Stitch)|Clyde]] are also present in Pleakley's E.A.R.W.A.X. group.{{cite web|url=http://lasfansite.atspace.me/stuff/history/tvtome/page04.html|title=L&S Says Mahalo|website={{WikipediaLink|TV.com|TV Tome}}|date=December 14, 2004|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305082355/http://lasfansite.atspace.me/stuff/history/tvtome/page04.html|archivedate=March 19, 2016|accessdate=May 27, 2018}} *In "Snafu", the captive Fibber did not buzz when [[Reuben]] lied about not being ticklish. Arguably, Reuben may have simply been unaware that he was ticklish, and therefore not lying. *Fibber is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed. *His number was also given to [[Hammerface]] in the English dub of the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. *Fibber's head appears in the online game ''[[Jumba's Lab]]''. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{L&S|Fibber (032)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Neutral characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]]

He was captured by [[Gantu]], but was rescued in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]". ==Background== ===Physical appearance=== Hammerface is a blue-gray dinosaur-like experiment with a hammer-shaped head/face, short forearms, small black eyes, a dense tail, and thick legs. He has claws all over his limbs and very sharp teeth. ===Powers and abilities=== True to his name, Hammerface can drive nails through any surface with his hammer-shaped head/face, but his strength allows him to pound living organisms. He also has some of the basic experiment attributes, including the substance on his hands and feet which allow him to scale walls. His tail is occasionally used as an extra support, a third leg. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 033 was the 33rd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to drive nails around Jumba's house, but he could hammer living organisms as well. 033 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 033's pod eventually made its way to a junk shop, where it (along with [[Heat|609]], [[Thresher|544]], and [[Plasmoid|617]]) was found, stolen, activated, and named Hammerface by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] in "[[Dupe (episode)|Dupe]]". Back at [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]], Gantu trained and conditioned Hammerface, Thresher, Heat, and Plasmoid by simply using [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] for target practice, much to his indignity and chagrin. The four henchmen experiments were then led by Gantu in an attack on the [[Lilo's House|Pelekais' house]], where their boss ordered them to defeat and capture [[Stitch]] and his duplicates after seeing that he had been split into four. Hammerface engaged one of the clones in a duel. The clone rolled into a ball and slammed into Hammerface, knocking the latter toward the wall, which he clung to. He then jumped onto the floor and ended the fight by slamming his hammer-like head on the opposite end of the floorboard the clone was on, catapulting him into Gantu's awaiting [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]]. After capturing Stitch and his clones, the five returned to Gantu's ship for a victory feast (courtesy of Reuben), but were interrupted by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Pleakley]], and [[Dupe]]. When Lilo tricked Gantu into using Dupe's cloning ability, Gantu used Dupe to clone Hammerface into a hundred replicas. However, as the original Hammerface's power was divided among them, they all became complete weaklings, and thus were easily defeated. Presumably after this, they were all sent to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] who was somehow able to remerge the weakling Hammerface clones into the original. In "[[The Asteroid]]", Hammerface was one of the six experiments that Stitch convinced to come with him and Lilo to save Earth from an approaching asteroid. Along the journey, [[Sparky (Lilo & Stitch)|Sparky]] teased Hammerface by shocking him, angering the latter. Later, the hammer-headed experiment started hitting [[Kixx]] on the head, only to be ordered otherwise by Pleakley (who referred to him as "Hammerhead" instead of "Hammerface"). In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Hammerface was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. In "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", Hammerface was sent back to Gantu along with all of Hämsterviel's other captive experiments after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused chaos and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. Hammerface reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by Lilo, Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission. ===''[[The Origin of Stitch]]''=== Hammerface was one of the experiments that were gliding on the screen, but he is 525 instead of 033. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Hammerface, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Hammerface participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Hammerface made an appearance in Season 2 of the ''Stitch!'' anime, along with [[Spike (Lilo & Stitch)|Spike]], [[Woody (Lilo & Stitch)|Woody]], [[Link]], and [[Babyfier]]. It is revealed that [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] reverted these experiments to evil using a recording of [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]]'s song, thus enabling them to wreak havoc on the [[Izayoi Island|island]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Hammerface is one of the ten known experiments named by someone other than Lilo or Stitch, the other nine being [[Gigi]], [[Elastico]], [[Yaarp]], [[Heat]], [[Thresher]], [[Plasmoid]], [[Morpholomew]], [[Shrink]], and [[Leroy]]. **Hammerface (alongside Heat, Thresher, and Plasmoid) was named by Gantu. *Hammerface is Experiment 033. However, in ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'', he is erroneously called 124, most likely due to Jumba's untidy [[Jumba's Computer|database]]. *In "[[The Asteroid]]", Pleakley referred to Hammerface as "Hammerhead". Presumably because his head is indeed shaped like a hammer. **Additionally, Hammerface was seen already activated, but because this episode was out of chronological order, he wasn't officially activated until the episode "[[Dupe (episode)|Dupe]]" aired. *Even though we saw Hammerface in [[Experiment Pods|pod]] form, he was technically activated off-screen. *Hammerface is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed. *In the English dub of the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime episode "Link-age", [[Reuben]] states that Hammerface's favorite type of sandwich is ham on flatbread. **Additionally, his number is mistaken for 032, which belongs to [[Fibber]]. ==External links== *{{L&S|Hammerface (033)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]]

He was designed to drown individuals by smothering them in his sweet, sticky chocolate. 054 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]].
