[[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Ploot''', also known as '''Experiment 505''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to ingest trash and pollution, growing exponentially larger as he collects more, then metabolizes the waste material into toxic sludge that he releases in order to cause environmental disasters. His one true place is cleaning up litter and pollution at [[Lahui Beach|the beach]]. ==Background== ===Personality=== Ploot has a two-sided nature, one that is benevolent and one that is chaotic. His initial appearance and helpful manner belie his true purpose and form: a giant ozone-polluting beast. In this form, he is very aggressive and dangerous, squirting pollution everywhere and harming those who get in his way, not even caring about the environment. However, after being sprayed with air freshener, Ploot's personality changed for the better, as he now cleans up the pollution and doesn't spit it out, helping to clean the environment as a result. ===Physical appearance=== Ploot is a small, blue-green gastropod-like experiment with a small green pouch, small black eyes, a thin mouth, green crab-like claws, and two spinning sweeper brushes for feet. In his pollution form, he is heftier, darker, and has green sludge dripping from his mouth. When in this form, his two antennae become like giant smokestacks, letting pollution into the air. ===Powers and abilities=== Ploot can suck in trash and pollution, growing exponentially bigger with all he collects. As he does so, he then spreads a thick toxic sludge created from the collected pollution to cause environmental disasters and becomes quite dangerous. He also appears to have gained control over his pollution form, since he turned into it to fight off [[Leroy]] [[Leroy Clones|clones]] with his cousins without an ill effect on his personality. ===Weaknesses=== Natural air freshener is shown to shrink/evaporate Ploot's toxic sludge and revert him to his normal size, as well as tame him and make him clean instead of pollute. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 505 was the 505th genetic experiment created by Jumba with [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to flood entire cities with toxic sludge created from accumulated trash and pollution, growing exponentially bigger as he collected more. 505 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 505's pod eventually made its way into a bag of trash, where it was thrown over a nearby cliff by a couple of polluters into [[Pudge]]'s underwater grotto, activating the experiment. 505, named Ploot, first began collecting all the pollution in the grotto, then started collecting trash throughout [[Kokaua Town|town]], but not before he was discovered by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] while they were busy cleaning up [[Lahui Beach|the beach]]. Unaware of what Ploot was really doing, Lilo and Stitch decided to let him carry out his primary function rather than attempt to stop him. However, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] later revealed Ploot's true intentions after Lilo informed him about the experiment. Eventually, Ploot collected enough trash and pollution to grow into a monstrous form, and then began his rampage by spreading toxic sludge around the island of Kauai. Before long, most of Kokaua Town was covered in Ploot's toxic goo, which contaminated everything, including Pudge's grotto. While an ailing Stitch was recuperating from an earlier garbage-eating incident (which Jumba theorized as a rare space disease), Lilo rallied several other experiments to try and stop Ploot from wrecking the environment. Despite their best efforts, Ploot was simply too strong for them. Ploot eventually kidnapped Lilo in one of his giant claws, ignoring her complaints about his destruction, but she was saved by Stitch, who had fully recovered from his illness. Lilo then defeated Ploot by using natural air freshener (a product that Jumba and [[Pleakley]] discovered) to reduce the latter to his original size. Ploot was then captured in a [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]] by Stitch, rehabilitated, and found a one true place cleaning up litter and pollution. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== Ploot was seen early in the movie cleaning up litter on the island as [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] was making her rounds with [[Scrump]] to make sure all the experiments were happy in the one true place they belonged. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Ploot, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Ploot participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], as he was seen in his alternate pollution form fighting attacking Leroys. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Ploot made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime where he grew to his monstrous size and polluted everything again. This also caused a chain reaction since the [[Izayoi Island|island]] was somehow the center of Earth's power, and it nearly destroyed the planet itself. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *In [[Ploot (episode)|his debut]], Ploot is erroneously called 515, a number taken by [[Deforestator]], who ironically appears in that episode as well. *The episode Ploot debuted in was aired on Earth Day. *Ploot, [[Shortstuff]], [[Clink]], [[Gotchu]], and two [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Leroy & Stitch|unconfirmed]] [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Comic Zone Volume 1: Disney's Lilo & Stitch|experiments]] are the only known experiments that have claws/pincers. His one true place is with [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] as one of her "cats". ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 507 was the 507th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to eat wood at a rapid rate. 507 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. Against statistically unlikely (but not impossible) odds, several experiment pods landed in one location: [[Mrs. Hasagawa]]'s yard, 507's pod being one of them. At an unknown point, [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] mistook 507's pod for an apricot and placed it in a colander for later consumption along with numerous other pods. When [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] redecorated Mrs. Hasagawa's front yard without her permission, she was less than thrilled with the results, but decided to thank them for their hard work with the "apricots." The pods were then revealed, but before Lilo and Stitch could stop her, she washed them with a watering can and thus activated the experiments. After his activation, 507 began to carry out his primary function by gnawing on one of the wooden beams that supported Mrs. Hasagawa's awning. Seeing him as a mere stray cat, she petted him and called him "kitty." When Lilo questioned this, Mrs. Hasagawa explained that several "unusual" stray cats come to live with her, the "kitties" turning out to be more experiments. The wooden beam 507 was gnawing on then crashed down, taking half of the awning with it. Lilo and Stitch believed the experiments to be a danger to Mrs. Hasagawa and along with [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]], decided to capture them all. Lilo was eventually able to capture 507 by placing a long plank of wood on the ground leading into a [[Prison Capsule|container]], and the experiment nibbled right into his capture. 507 and the other experiments were about to be taken away, but were returned to Mrs. Hasagawa when Lilo and Stitch saw how much she cared for them. 507 was then named Woody. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Woody, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Woody participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Woody made an appearance in Season 2 of the ''Stitch!'' anime, along with [[Hammerface]], [[Babyfier]], [[Link]], and [[Spike (Lilo & Stitch)|Spike]]. It is revealed that [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] reverted these experiments to evil using a recording of [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]]'s song, thus enabling them to wreak havoc on the [[Izayoi Island|island]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink|Woody}} ==Trivia== *Woody's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue. *In the English dub of the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime episode "Link-age", [[Reuben]] states that Woody's favorite type of sandwich is anything fibrous. ==External links== *{{L&S|Woody (507)|Woody}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Woody}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Beavers]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Neutral characters]] [[Category:Pets]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]]

He is designed to sprout into an uncontrollable forest of destruction by burrowing into the ground and producing tendrils that grow replicas of his head. His one true place is atop the pineapple water tower. ==Background== ===Personality=== Sprout is wild and tends to be aggressive, often trying to bite individuals when he was still confined in a flower pot. After he rooted into the ground and grew to enormous proportions, he became very dangerous, spreading his vines like weeds to attack victims. However, he apparently calmed down after being uprooted and contained. He also seems to like [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]. ===Physical appearance=== Sprout is a plant-like experiment with a purple {{WikipediaLink|Venus flytrap}}-shaped head, giving him a lizard-like face and sharp teeth. He has dark blue pupil-less eyes, three leaves surrounding his head like a frill, and a single antenna on his head. His body is leaf-like, with a thick green stem extending to his head and containing eight tentacle-like vines. ===Powers and abilities=== Sprout can grow from a small experiment to an immense monstrosity at a rapid rate. Using his burrowing capabilities, Sprout can initiate his growth once he roots into the ground, allowing him to sprout a destructive forest of vicious duplicates, and sends out tendrils that can grow new heads and act like weeds, all with replicas of Sprout's head. ===Weaknesses=== If the original Sprout's roots are separated from the forest and contained, all of his duplicates will die off. Sprout is also vulnerable to plant-trimming or weed-cutting machines, such as a tractor or lawn mower. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 509 was the 509th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to spawn into an uncontrollable killer forest. 509 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. 509's pod eventually made its way into a post office, where [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] found it on the floor while mailing a letter to her pen pal Henry. She then took the pod [[Lilo's House|home]] to [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] who described 509's powers, but Jumba, unwilling to risk activating 509 due to the destruction the latter would cause, locked the pod away. Since Lilo wanted to enter something in one of the competitions, she and [[Stitch]] stealthily stole 509's pod from Jumba's desk drawer the following night. Lilo then activated the experiment, named him Sprout, transplanted him, and fed him super-fertilizer. The next day, Lilo took a rapidly-growing Sprout to an orchid competition at the [[Kokaua Town]] fair. When [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] approached Sprout and noticed he was not an orchid, Sprout lashed out at her, causing Mertle to accidentally break his pot open. Sprout then rooted into the ground and grew into a massive forest of killer plants which took over the fair, causing widespread panic and Stitch to lose the rodeo to [[Zach Makeli|a five-time champion cowboy]]. [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] and Jumba soon learned of the disaster that was broadcast on TV and became angry with Lilo for activating Sprout against Jumba's wishes. Eventually, Stitch managed to lasso the original Sprout, uproot him, and drag him into a pineapple-shaped water tower slated for demolition, thus trapping the latter and causing the forest to die off without the original Sprout. Lilo was unsure if this was truly Sprout's one true place, but it was apparently the best she and Stitch could do on such short notice. Sprout was seen on a computer screen in "[[Ace (episode)|Ace]]", posing as an evil creation of Jumba's as part of a hoax to fool [[Mortlegax]], the head of E.G.O. industries. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Sprout, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Sprout participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroy clones soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. Sprout joins them for the song by playing the drums. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== [[File:Stitch! - Son of Sprout - Giant Sproutling grabs the whole gang.jpg|thumb|Sprout in the anime episode "Son of Sprout"; in the English dub, he is actually a Sproutling instead.]] Sprout was mentioned twice in the ''Stitch!'' anime. Although Sprout reappeared twice in the [[Japan]]ese version of the anime, he makes no appearances in the English dub, where he was mentioned by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] to still live on Kauai. Instead, in both appearances, they are a seedling spawned from Sprout called a '''Sproutling''', codenamed '''Experiment 509-A'''. It is revealed that Sprout can produce seed pods and launch them into space, where they cling to asteroids. A seedling first appeared in "Son of Sprout". It had attached to a meteor that later crashed onto [[Izayoi Island]]. Once it got its roots into the ground, it quickly began to grow, carrying out his father's original programming, before eventually being neutralized. In "Sprout 2.0", [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] reveals that he has enhanced another one of Sprout's seedlings with the DNA of [[627|Experiment 627]], disguised it as a plant, and hid it on a deserted island in an attempt to capture [[Stitch]]. [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] and [[Reuben]] disguise themselves and convince Stitch and the gang to go find a flower that grants wishes, but is truly the seedling. Shortly after arriving on the island, the gang finds and almost instantly captures the seedling. However, when the seedling escapes, 627's DNA causes him to grow and become unstoppable. Luckily, this also gave the seedling 627's only weakness: laughter. Eventually, Stitch and the others defeat the seedling by tickling him to submission, causing him to shrink back to his original size. In "Shogun", it is shown that Sprout was dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in Jumba's vault. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Sprout was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'' in the experiment gallery. *Sprout is an obvious parody of [[w:c:villains:Audrey II|Audrey II]] from ''{{WikipediaLink|Little Shop of Horrors (film)|Little Shop of Horrors}}''. *Sprout bears a great resemblance to most real-life {{WikipediaLink|Venus flytrap|Venus flytraps}}. *Sprout's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue. *Sprout's holographic silhouette appeared in both "[[Amnesio (episode)|Amnesio]]" and "[[Fibber (episode)|Fibber]]". **Sprout is shown to have two different graphic designs on [[Jumba's Computer|Jumba's computer]]. *During the battle between the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy army]] and the experiments in ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]'', Sprout did not grow into an uncontrollable forest of destruction like he did in [[Sprout (episode)|his debut]]. *In the English dub of ''[[Stitch!]]'', Sprout is said to produce seeds called Sproutlings (a.k.a. However, the international version attempted to fit the anime into the canon of ''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]'', and so Sprout stays in [[Hawaii]], whereas instead, both of his appearances are considered to be seedlings that he has spawned. *As a reference to many experiments being mislabeled with the excuse that Jumba's database is untidy, [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] and [[Reuben]] ask if the experiment used to enhance the Sproutling was 672 or 726, and not [[627]]. Milkshake shaking |paraphernalia = Tail |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Richter''', also known as '''Experiment 513''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to cause geological disruption; his programming allows him to locate the weakest geological point from which he can create massive earthquakes capable of causing planets to bifurcate. His one true place is shaking milkshakes at the [[Rental Hut|Rental Shack]]. ==Background== ===Personality=== Despite his destructive function, Richter is shown to care for things and share [[Stitch]]'s fondness for the orange ball that both of them cherish. He is simple-minded and comes off as very stubborn when confronted. He has a one-track mind and tends to let his actions speak louder than words a lot of the time. He is also very sneaky and cunning, capable of causing trouble and mischief whenever he gets a chance to do so. Richter can be quite a good friend to those who win his trust. He is also shown to be loyal and helpful to his friends, joining Stitch's rebellion to fight off [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]. ===Physical appearance=== Richter is a quadrupedal, bulky, purple experiment resembling an [[Ankylosaurus]]. He has a huge flat tail with a triangular shaped portion at the end, a round face with a wide mouth with two of his bottom teeth sticking out, and a single horn on his head. He also has a lavender stomach, chest, and patches around his eyes, a large reddish-brown round nose, large black eyes, small, short pointed ears, tiny dark purple round spikes down his back, and a darker purple marking in the middle of his back that reaches all the way to his tail. ===Powers and abilities=== Richter has incredible strength and can generate concussive force via specific body movements, such as shaking things with his paws when making milkshakes or thumping his tail to the ground when causing devastating earthquakes. If he uses his latter ability in faults within Earth's crust, he can also set off a chain reaction of quakes which will split the entire planet in two if not countered with the backfire effect. Like Stitch, Richter can roll into a ball and climb walls, but is too heavy to jump. He sticks close to the ground due to being a quadruped, but he is capable of standing on two legs if he so desires. He also has a knack for treating things preciously like Stitch's orange ball (or "citrus orb", as [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] describes it). ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 513 was the 513th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to use his earthquake-making ability to split entire planets in two. 513 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 513's pod landing in a palm tree by a [[Lahui Beach|beach]]. 513's pod fell out of the tree and into a drink cooler below, the melting ice activating the experiment. 513 then created a deadly earthquake with one thump of his tail, causing massive damage throughout the beach, before the experiment escaped in search of an underground fault. 513 was later intercepted by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]], but the former managed to escape them and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] into a dormant volcano. Lilo and Stitch followed 513 into the volcano and attempted to encase him in green sticky goo, but the latter was able to force them out and cave in the entrance. 513 then set off a chain reaction in the volcano's fault, which would eventually cause a chain reaction of quakes and split the entire planet in two. Later, Lilo and Stitch returned to the dormant volcano using a [[X-Buggy|drill machine]], and, despite 513's best efforts to evade them, they were eventually able to corner him. However, Gantu arrived at that moment, capturing 513 in a [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]] and taking him back to [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]] to send to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. Gantu prepared to teleport 513 to Hämsterviel. However, due to Lilo and Stitch's timely arrival, as well as interference caused by the vibrations, they managed to rescue 513 before Gantu could transport him, resulting in Gantu being teleported instead. Lilo and Stitch took the recaptured 513, christened Richter, to a fissure, where he could create another chain reaction of quakes that would counter the first in a backfire effect. Richter agreed to do so if he could have Stitch's orange ball, which the latter had been treating very preciously after Lilo taught him how to care for things. Lilo then released Richter from containment, and the latter quickly went underground and successfully stopped the quake. After being dug out of the ground, Richter earned Stitch's orange ball and found his one true place at the [[Rental Hut|Rental Shack]] shaking milkshakes. In "[[Holio (episode)|Holio]]", Richter helped repair the Rental Hut after it was nearly destroyed by [[Holio|Experiment 606]]. Richter reappeared in "[[Elastico (episode)|Elastico]]" as one of the audience members for Lilo's hula dance. In "[[Finder (episode)|Finder]]", Richter was seen playing poker with Stitch, [[Yin]], [[Yang]], and [[Cannonball]]. In "[[Dupe (episode)|Dupe]]", Richter was one of the experiments that came to Lilo and Stitch's slumber party wearing children's sleepers. However, he was forced by [[Pleakley]] to leave due to his destructive behavior. In "[[Angel (episode)|Angel]]", Richter was one of the experiments that [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]] reverted to evil using her song, causing the former to create massive earthquakes. Later, Richter and the other depraved experiments attacked Stitch aboard a ship, but Angel turned them to good again before they could finish Stitch off. Working together, the experiments were then able to successfully escape the ship with Stitch. Richter reappeared in "[[Slugger (episode)|Slugger]]" as part of Lilo's softball team. Richter was one of the experiments in "[[Checkers (episode)|Checkers]]" that joined Stitch in a rebellion against Gantu. In "[[Ploot (episode)|Ploot]]", Richter was one of the first team of experiments (along with [[Kixx]] and [[Deforestator]]) formed to try and stop [[Ploot]]. However, Ploot was easily able to defeat them, forcing the three experiments to retreat. Richter was seen on a computer screen in "[[Ace (episode)|Ace]]", posing as an evil creation of [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s as part of a hoax to fool [[Mortlegax]], the head of E.G.O. industries. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Richter, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Richter participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by creating quakes that opened up fissures in the earth, which trapped the Leroys. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]," which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. Cannonball walks by bouncing around on his butt, and he can also roll into a ball while in midair and fight enemies by flattening them with his butt. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 520 was the 520th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to turn bodies of water into huge, destructive waves and tsunamis. 520 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch |Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 520's pod landing in a bird's nest. When a bird discovered 520's pod in its nest, it kicked the pod out, which landed in a nearby lake, activating the experiment. 520 then created a massive tsunami in the lake and began to casually make his way towards the ocean, where he would cause an even deadlier tsunami. While 520 evaded [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]'s clutches, the former passed through the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel]], where he created a tsunami from one of the pools that devastated much of the hotel. In the aftermath, 520 used the diving board to propel himself up until he landed atop a palm tree, where [[Stitch]] incompetently catapulted him away, much to [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s discouragement. 520 later made his way to a reservoir while being pursued by Lilo and Stitch, but before he could cause a tsunami, Stitch fired a suction cup dart attached to a rope at 520 and reeled him in. However, Gantu attacked and captured 520, who was almost stuffed into a [[Net Cannon|net]]. Stitch battled Gantu and slipped a pineapple inside his net, leaving Gantu taking the net with the pineapple back to [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]], while 520 had been recaptured in a [[Prison Capsule|container]]. Lilo and Stitch then released 520, and after assuring him that they meant him no harm, the three rushed off to [[Lahui Beach|the beach]] for Lilo's sand-sculpting competition. Stitch and 520 played contentedly until Gantu came by to try and capture 520 one more time, forcing Stitch to build a life-size sand fortress around himself, Lilo, and 520. When Gantu began to tear into the sand castle, 520 jumped from the castle into the ocean, where the latter created a massive tsunami that washed Gantu away to [[San Francisco]], while leaving the island perfectly intact. 520, christened Cannonball, later found his one true place making suitable waves for surfing. Cannonball reappeared in "[[Elastico (episode)|Elastico]]" as one of the audience members for Lilo's hula dance. Cannonball made a cameo at the end of "[[Swirly (episode)|Swirly]]", where he slid into a children's wading pool. In "[[Houdini (episode)|Houdini]]", Cannonball was one of the audience members for Stitch's bungled magic act. In "[[Finder (episode)|Finder]]", Cannonball was seen playing poker with Stitch, [[Yin]], [[Yang]], and [[Richter]]. In "[[Dupe (episode)|Dupe]]", Cannonball was one of the experiments that came to Lilo and Stitch's slumber party wearing traditional pajamas. However, he was forced by [[Pleakley]] to leave due to his destructive behavior. In "[[Angel (episode)|Angel]]", Cannonball was one of the experiments that [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]] reverted to evil using her song. Later, Cannonball and the other depraved experiments attacked Stitch aboard a ship, but Angel turned them to good again before they could finish Stitch off. Working together, the experiments were then able to successfully escape the ship with Stitch. Cannonball made another cameo in "[[Felix (episode)|Felix]]", where he was destroying the beach with his tidal waves. He was eventually stopped by Stitch, and while Lilo convinced Cannonball to tone down his waves, Stitch cleaned up the beach. Cannonball was one of the experiments in "[[Checkers (episode)|Checkers]]" that joined Stitch in a rebellion against Gantu. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Cannonball was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== In the film's opening, Cannonball can be seen waving hello to [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], along with [[Yin]] and [[Yang]]. He was also seen later in the movie making perfect waves for surfing as Lilo was making her rounds with [[Scrump]] to make sure all the experiments were happy in the one true place they belonged. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Cannonball, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Cannonball participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by flattening attacking Leroys with his butt. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ==Video games== ===''[[Disney Emoji Blitz]]''=== Cannonball appears in ''Disney Emoji Blitz'' only in a cameo during [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]]'s Power (along with [[Sparky (Lilo & Stitch)|Sparky]] and [[Reuben]]), but he is unplayable. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Cannonball was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! After freeing the one-eyed alien, she used the wrapping as a makeshift lasso to save Mrs. Hasagawa when she was blown into the air by [[Blowhard|Experiment 533]]. 521 and the other experiments were about to be taken away, but were returned to Mrs. Hasagawa when Lilo and Stitch saw how much she cared for them. 521 was then named Wrapper. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Wrapper, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. Regeneration |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Slushy''', also known as '''Experiment 523''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to be a freeze inducer, making mostly ice and snow. As his deep-freeze programming continues, he creates icy blizzards, mile-high snowdrifts, and keeps all leftovers edible for six months. His one true place is making [[Luki's Shave Ice|shave ice]] with [[Dupe]]. ==Background== ===Personality=== Slushy is an icy experiment with a one-track mind. He greatly dislikes the heat, but is very short-tempered about this. He is playful and often likes to play with his "cousins" by starting snowball fights, though sometimes enjoys messing with his victims by making the ground slippery or freezing something they need. He is known to be aggressive and apparently shares a grudge with [[Splodyhead]] due to his opposing element, but they resolved it in "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]". ===Physical appearance=== Slushy is an icy blue experiment who appears to be made from ice. Because of this, he has little to no body features aside from limbs, mouth, blue eyes, a blue-green koala-like nose, and a few icicles behind his head. ===Powers and abilities=== Slushy's ice breath is able to blast gusts of ice and snow ranging from a simple snow-cone to a massive blizzard. He can also meld weapons with his icy breath, strong enough to repel fire without melting, and freeze plasma blasts into simple clumps of snow. Slushy can also regenerate himself after being broken into blocks of ice. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 523 was the 523rd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to make ice and snow, but could use these powers to convert areas into frozen tundras. 523 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 523's pod landing atop a vending machine. When [[Stitch]] shook the vending machine while trying to get a soda, 523's pod fell out and rolled into a nearby storm drain, the sewage activating the experiment, whose icy blast froze the grating. After freezing the top of another storm drain at a [[Kauai Airport|helicopter base]], 523 emerged from it and then stowed away aboard a helicopter, where he proceeded to cover the entire island in snow. Stitch somehow vandalized the soda machine after it malfunctioned before he and [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] discovered the snowy weather in [[Kokaua Town]]. Stitch was disconcerted by the snow, while Lilo became fascinated and dragged Stitch [[Lilo's House|home]] to consult [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], who revealed 523's powers to them. Later, Lilo and Stitch engaged 523 in battle, resulting in the experiment freezing Stitch in ice. 523 then attempted to do the same to Lilo, but the former was blasted into a [[Net Cannon|net]] and captured in a [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]] by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]. However, when Lilo freed Stitch from the ice with a [[Plasma Blaster|blaster]], the latter managed to get 523 back from Gantu after a brief struggle. 523, named Slushy by Lilo, was then taken back to their house, where Lilo convinced him to cover their dwelling in more snow for a little winter fun. Although Stitch initially rejected the snow, as it was a form of water, he soon joined Lilo outside and did some ice skating and sledding with her. However, while they were busy playing in the snow, Gantu arrived and recaptured Slushy. The former then forced the experiment to cover the island in a massive blizzard and create a huge, impenetrable ice fortress for Gantu and [[Reuben|Experiment 625]]. Sometime later, Lilo and Stitch traveled to the ice fortress to defeat Slushy. They built two snow replicas of themselves as bait, which Gantu blasted, enabling them to sneak past him and Reuben. However, Slushy spotted Lilo and Stitch inside and managed to trap them under four giant icicles. Fortunately, Jumba and [[Pleakley]] arrived with [[Splodyhead]], who took on Slushy. A long-drawn-out battle ensued between Slushy and Splodyhead, which ended when the former froze the latter into a block of ice. Splodyhead was later freed and blasted a fireball into the sky at the top of [[Waialeale Peak]] to clear Slushy's snowstorms, while an overthrown Gantu came down with a cold. After Slushy was defeated and recaptured, Lilo and Stitch found him a one true place making [[Luki's Shave Ice|shave ice]]. Slushy reappeared in "[[Elastico (episode)|Elastico]]" as one of the audience members for Lilo's hula dance. In "[[Angel (episode)|Angel]]", Slushy was one of the experiments that [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]] reverted to evil using her song, causing the former to go on a rampage by freezing the town (including Stitch and Pleakley). Later, Slushy and the other depraved experiments attacked Stitch aboard a ship, but Angel turned them to good again before they could finish Stitch off. Working together, the experiments were then able to successfully escape the ship with Stitch. In "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]", Slushy was one of the experiments in Pleakley's E.A.R.W.A.X. group. When Slushy created and threw a snowball at Pleakley with boredom, it accidentally hit Splodyhead and a battle ensued between the two experiments, which ended when Pleakley convinced Slushy and Splodyhead to attempt hugging therapy on each other. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Slushy was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. Slushy and Splodyhead were seen on a computer screen in "[[Ace (episode)|Ace]]", posing as evil creations of Jumba's as part of a hoax to fool [[Mortlegax]], the head of E.G.O. industries. In "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", Slushy and [[Dupe]] were seen using their combined powers to sell multiple low-calorie shave ice cones that [[Charles and Mary|a couple]] bought and enjoyed. Gantu then attempted to revert the rehabilitated experiments to evil by playing a recording of Angel's song with Reuben's help, but due to interference from [[Snafu|Experiment 120]], Gantu's karaoke tape was played instead, much to Slushy and Dupe's humor. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== In the film's opening, Slushy can be seen with [[Poki]] as the former sells shave ice. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Slushy, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Slushy participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by freezing oncoming waves of attacking Leroys with his ice breath. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Slushy made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime, along with [[Pix]], [[Boomer (Lilo & Stitch)|Boomer]], [[Blowhard]], [[Kixx]], and [[Slugger]], when [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] and [[Stitch]] visited [[Tokyo Disneyland]]. He made a second appearance along with [[Sinker]], in which [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] used both of them to attack a cruise ship that he had lured Stitch onto. After being defeated, Slushy was reverted back to normal, then dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Slushy wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. He later appeared in the specials ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand'' and ''Stitch! Perfect Memory''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *When Slushy is activated, Gantu mentions that the ice and snowfields created by Slushy remind him of his home world. He is designed to immobilize objects and victims by flying them like kites with blasts of wind. His one true place is with [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] as one of her "cats". ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 533 was the 533rd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to immobilize enemies by flying them like kites. 533 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. Against statistically unlikely (but not impossible) odds, several experiment pods landed in one location: [[Mrs. Hasagawa]]'s yard, 533's pod being one of them. At an unknown point, [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] mistook 533's pod for an apricot and placed it in a colander for later consumption along with numerous other pods. After [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] redecorated Mrs. Hasagawa's front yard without her permission, she was less than thrilled with the results, but decided to thank them for their hard work with the "apricots." The pods were then revealed, but before Lilo and Stitch could stop her, she washed them with a watering can, thus activating the experiments. After he was activated, 533 began to carry out his primary function by attempting to blow away Mrs. Hasagawa's shirt which had been hanging on a clothesline. However, Stitch quickly tied the clothesline to the pole with a strong knot, leaving 533 to blow at it in vain. Later, while Lilo, Stitch, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], and [[Pleakley]] were capturing all the experiments that Mrs. Hasagawa kept as pets, believing them to be a danger to her, she saw 533 as another stray cat and started petting him, only to get blown away herself. Fortunately, Lilo made a makeshift lasso out of [[Wrapper|521]]'s wrapping and anchored Mrs. Hasagawa, who was then slowly reeled in. When she was safely on the ground, Stitch captured 533 in a [[Prison Capsule|container]]. 533 and the other experiments were about to be taken away, but were returned to Mrs. Hasagawa when Lilo and Stitch saw how much she cared for them. Soon after, he blew Jumba and Pleakley aloft like kites, much to Stitch's amusement, with the two aliens each trying to convince the other to fly higher due to being made extra polite by [[Manners|Experiment 358]]. 533 was then named Blowhard. In "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", Blowhard was oddly seen as one of the captive experiments in [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison cell]], although he is barely seen, suggesting [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] caught Blowhard, but this was an error. Blowhard was then sent back to Gantu after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused mischief and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Blowhard, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Blowhard participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] probably by flying attacking Leroys like kites. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Blowhard made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime, along with [[Pix]], [[Boomer (Lilo & Stitch)|Boomer]], [[Slushy]], [[Kixx]], and [[Slugger]], when [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] and [[Stitch]] visited [[Tokyo Disneyland]]. ==Trivia== *Blowhard's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue. *Blowhard, [[Felix (Lilo & Stitch)|Felix]], [[Phoon]], and one [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Leroy & Stitch|unconfirmed experiment]] are the only known experiments that have trunks similar to elephants and tapirs. **Blowhard and Phoon are also the only known experiments with primary functions directly involving wind, and both of their names relate to wind as well. *In "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", Blowhard erroneously appeared with Gantu's other captive experiments, although he is barely seen, but he was already living with Mrs. Hasagawa, and Lilo and Stitch discovered him while Gantu was asleep. *Blowhard is one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. ==Gallery== ===Screenshots=== L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats - Blowhard's experiment pod.jpg|Blowhard's experiment pod L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 9.jpg L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 12.png L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 85.png L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 86.png L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 90.jpg Blowhard blowing Jumba and Pleakley like kites.jpg L&S - 2x24B - Woops 5.jpg Leroy & Stitch - Experiments scared of cannon.png Stitch! [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Phoon''', also known as '''Experiment 540''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. She is designed to create devastating, typhoon-like winds; in her mutated form, she has enhanced strength and can fire projectiles at enemies, while her blasts are more powerful. Her one true place is creating winds for windsurfers at [[Lahui Beach|the beach]]. ==Background== ===Personality=== Phoon is playful and energetic, hopping around cheerfully after being activated while taking in her surroundings. However, she also enjoys causing destruction, as she proves to be conniving and giggles mischievously as she destroys things with her powerful wind gusts. When [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] accidentally mutates her with his [[Plasmatic Englobulatron]], she becomes quite aggressive and furious while she continues to destroy things. She dislikes when individuals try to stop her and will attack anyone who does. However, she enjoys being rocked and hearing lullabies, which soothe her and put her to sleep, as well as reverts her to her normal size. After being reformed, she decides to use her powers on a lighter level for individuals to enjoy her wind for windsurfing. However, she will use her powers to defend herself when need be, such as during the battle against the [[Leroy]] [[Leroy Clones|clones]]. ===Physical appearance=== Phoon is a quadrupedal, red, round-bodied elephant-like experiment with green eyes and eyelashes, two tails, a short trunk, and four legs (two of which can serve as arms). She has a dark red stripe pattern with bumps running down her back and a light-colored underbelly. In her mutated form, she is massively larger and walks upright instead of quadrupedal. She now has three spines sticking out of her head. In addition, her eyes are slanted downward to make her appear menacing. Her teeth and claws are more pronounced in this form, as they are shown sticking out and are never retracted. ===Powers and abilities=== Using her trunk, Phoon can create massive wind blasts and wind tunnels by sucking up vast amounts of air and blowing it out with enormous forces. When applied to Jumba's [[Plasmatic Englobulatron|Plasmatic Englobulatron ray]], Phoon mutates to a larger, more powerful form in which she has enhanced strength and can fire projectiles at enemies. In this form, her blasts are greatly enhanced as well. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 540 was the 540th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. She was designed to produce destructive, typhoon-like winds. 540 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 540's pod landing on a rooftop weather vane. A breeze caused 540's pod to fall off the weather vane into the roof's rain gutter and roll down into a rain barrel, activating the experiment. 540 then created a powerful typhoon-like wind and proceeded to destroy the house. Later, 540 blew down some palm trees near [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]]. When [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] went out to try and capture 540, the latter blew a tree onto Gantu's head. The resulting concussion left him confused and disoriented, which [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] took great notice, but Gantu still resumed searching for 540. Meanwhile, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] decided to temporarily quit experiment hunting after an unfortunate mishap. She then attended Hip Hop Fusion, where she impressed some rich hippie girls by telling falsehoods about her life. When Gantu later came to the school, thinking Lilo was hiding the experiment from him, Lilo tried to cover up the situation by telling the hippie girls that Gantu was her eccentric uncle Chester who wasn't quite right in the head. Due to his concussion caused by the blow he took earlier, Gantu believed the lies that Lilo told the hippie girls and ended up thinking that aliens were only figments of his imagination. He then decided to go surfing at [[Lahui Beach|the beach]]. Shortly after, [[Stitch]] (dubbed Wenceslaus by Lilo) arrived and attempted to tell Lilo about 540's hurricane. The hippie girls initially questioned Stitch's body language, but then assumed he was an exotic pet. Unfazed by their opinion, Stitch tagged along with Lilo and the hippie girls. Later on, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] tracked 540 down, where Jumba tested his latest invention, the [[Plasmatic Englobulatron]], in hopes of catching 540, despite Pleakley's objection to this. Instead, the ray mutated her into a gigantic monster (as stated by Jumba: "76.3% chance will instantly capture experiment, 23.5% chance will destroy entire planet with big boom. This was other 0.2% chance."). After blowing down Jumba and Pleakley, 540 resumed her rampage. Meanwhile, a delusional Gantu was chilling at the beach, while Reuben tried to tell the former that if he didn't catch 540, [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] would be furious. However, Gantu ignored Reuben, even after the latter managed to get Hämsterviel on the phone, thinking both were figments of his imagination. Hämsterviel then subtly advised Reuben to kick Gantu in the rear. In doing so, Gantu immediately came to his senses and set off in search of 540. Sometime later, 540 arrived at Hip Hop Fusion and wreaked havoc with her devastating blasts of wind. She was soon followed by Jumba and Pleakley, and later Gantu. When the hippie girls grew suspicious, Lilo was forced to lie to them even more. The mutated 540 destroyed a large portion of [[Kokaua Town]] until Stitch arrived and, after a long battle, succeeded in putting 540 to sleep by rocking her in his arms while singing a lullaby. This caused the Plasmatic Englobulatron effect to wear off, and 540 shrunk down to her normal size and form. When Gantu then attempted to capture 540 in a [[Prison Capsule|container]], Stitch drooled menacingly, forcing Gantu to surrender. 540, christened Phoon, later found her one true place at the beach providing gusts of wind for windsurfers. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Phoon, were round up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]] and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Phoon participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by creating cyclones that sucked up attacking Leroys and hurled them through the air. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Phoon made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime where the gang went back in time and tampered with [[Stitch]]'s creation, which started up his glitch and therefore almost erased him from existence. Phoon, along with [[Ace]] and [[Sparky (Lilo & Stitch)|Sparky]], helped gather enough energy to re-energize Stitch. She later appeared in the special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *In [[Phoon (episode)|her debut episode]], Lilo refers to Phoon as a male, despite Phoon clearly being a female based on her voice and the presence of eyelashes. *Phoon's wind blasts are actually recycled sounds of [[Hathi, Jr.]]'s trumpeting from ''[[The Jungle Book]]''. *Phoon is one of the rare experiments to not have black eyes like most experiments, having green eyes instead. *Phoon, [[Felix (Lilo & Stitch)|Felix]], [[Blowhard]], and one [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Leroy & Stitch|unconfirmed experiment]] are the only known experiments that have trunks similar to elephants and tapirs. **Phoon and Blowhard are also the only known experiments with primary functions directly involving wind, and both of their names relate to wind as well. *Phoon, along with [[Gigi]], [[Dorkifier]], [[Nosox]], [[Experiments#2-Series: Technological and scientific|Butter]], [[Shortstuff]], [[Spike (Lilo & Stitch)|Spike]], [[Yang]], [[Richter]], [[Tank (Lilo & Stitch)|Tank]], [[Splodyhead]], and one [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Leroy & Stitch|unconfirmed experiment]], are the only known experiments that are primarily quadrupeds. *Phoon's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue. *The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Phoon as: "Experiment 540. Primary function: Generates devastating wind blasts." *In ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]'', both Phoon's mutated and normal forms appeared, possibly indicating that she has learned to morph in between the forms. ==External links== *{{L&S|Phoon (540)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Giants]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]]

In his transmutated form in ''[[Stitch!]]'', he looks more muscular and has bright orange eyes. ===Powers and abilities=== Thresher can thrash crops or beat his victims up with his six extendable, mace-like tentacles. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 544 was the 544th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to smash up crops with his mace-like tentacles, although he could also use them to attack and battle enemies. 544 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 544's pod eventually made its way to a junk shop, where it (along with [[Hammerface|033]], [[Heat|609]], and [[Plasmoid|617]]) was found, stolen, activated, and named Thresher by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] in "[[Dupe (episode)|Dupe]]". Back at [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]], Gantu trained and conditioned Hammerface, Heat, Thresher, and Plasmoid by simply using [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] for target practice, much to his indignity and chagrin. The four henchmen experiments were then led by Gantu in an attack on the [[Lilo's House|Pelekais' house]], where their boss ordered them to defeat and capture [[Stitch]] and his duplicates after seeing that he had been split into four. Thresher engaged one of the clones in a duel. The clone picked up a broom and started spinning it similar to a bo staff. While he did this in front of Thresher, the latter appeared to be mesmerized, but stretched out one of his mace-tipped tentacles and poked the clone in the shoulder. When the clone turned his head, Thresher aimed another tentacle at his victim's face. [[Pleakley]], seeing Thresher's plan, tried to warn the clone but was too late, as Thresher managed to knock him unconscious. The slug-like experiment then used his long tentacles to pick up his defeated opponent and place him in one of Gantu's [[Prison Capsule|containment orbs]]. After capturing Stitch and his clones, the five returned to Gantu's ship for a victory feast (courtesy of Reuben), but were interrupted by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], Pleakley, and [[Dupe]]. When Lilo tricked Gantu into using Dupe's cloning ability, Gantu used Dupe to clone Thresher into a hundred replicas. However, as the original Thresher's power was divided among them, they all became complete weaklings, and thus were easily defeated. Presumably after this, they were all sent to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] who was somehow able to remerge the weakling Thresher clones into the original. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Thresher was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. Although Thresher was unseen in "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", he is known to have been sent back to Gantu along with all of Hämsterviel's other captive experiments after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused chaos and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. Thresher reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by Lilo, Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Thresher, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Thresher participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], as during the climax, when Stitch points to the stage in the stadium, Thresher can be seen bonking a Leroy clone on the head. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. Thresher joins them for the song by playing the marimba. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Thresher made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime where [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] used him to attack [[Stitch]] during a magic show. In this episode, he looks more muscular and has bright orange eyes. He later appeared in the special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Thresher is one of the ten known experiments named by someone other than Lilo or Stitch, the other nine being [[Gigi]], [[Elastico]], [[Yaarp]], [[Hammerface]], [[Heat]], [[Plasmoid]], [[Morpholomew]], [[Shrink]], and [[Leroy]]. **Thresher (alongside Hammerface, Heat, and Plasmoid) was named by Gantu. *Some sources have spelled this experiment's name as "Thrasher", but "Thresher" is the correct spelling. *Thresher is one of the rare experiments to have sclerae and pupils instead of solid black eyes, the others being [[Clink]], [[Skip]], [[Bragg]], [[Nosox]], [[Mr. Stenchy]], [[Mrs. Sickly]], [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Comic Zone Volume 1: Disney's Lilo & Stitch|Tippy]], [[Experiments#3-Series: Psychological|Slobber]], and [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Comic Zone Volume 1: Disney's Lilo & Stitch|four unconfirmed experiments]]. *Thresher, [[Huggo]], and Clink are the only known experiments with stalked eyes, a trait common in the invertebrates that all three are inspired by. *Thresher and Huggo have very similar heads/faces. Perhaps they were created using some of the same DNA. *Even though we saw Thresher in [[Experiment Pods|pod]] form, he was technically activated off-screen. *Thresher is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed. ==External links== *{{L&S|Thresher (544)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]]

He is designed to drill potholes in hard surfaces. His one true place is with [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] as one of her "cats." ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 566 was the 566th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to drill potholes. 566 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. Against statistically unlikely (but not impossible) odds, several experiment pods landed in one location: [[Mrs. Hasagawa]]'s yard, 566's pod being one of them. At an unknown point, [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] mistook 566's pod for an apricot and placed it in a colander for later consumption along with numerous other pods. After [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] redecorated Mrs. Hasagawa's front yard without her permission, she was less than thrilled with the results, but decided to thank them for their hard work with the "apricots." The pods were then revealed, but before Lilo and Stitch could stop her, she washed them with a watering can, thus activating the experiments. After his activation, 566 began to carry out his primary function by drilling potholes in Mrs. Hasagawa's floor. Lilo and Stitch believed the experiments to be a danger to Mrs. Hasagawa and, along with [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]], decided to capture them all. 566 was then [[Prison Capsule|captured]] by unknown means. 566 and the other experiments were about to be taken away, but were returned to Mrs. Hasagawa when Lilo and Stitch saw how much she cared for them. 566 was then named Derrick. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Derrick, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], Pleakley, [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Derrick participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ==Trivia== *Derrick was activated off-screen. *Derrick is very similar to [[Splat]] in that they both do construction work. *Derrick, [[Backhoe]], and [[Digger]], are the only known experiments whose powers are related to excavation. *Derrick is one of the only four known experiments that wears a hat, the other three being [[Squeak]], [[Frenchfry]], and [[Slick]]. However, it is unknown if Derrick can remove his hat or not, while it is presumed Squeak can take off his hat since he appears with a fresh hat in [[Leroy & Stitch|the TV film finale]] after an earlier incident with the Evil-liminator, and Frenchfry's "hat" appears to be a part of his head, while Slick is wearing a true hat that he can remove. *Derrick is one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''Leroy & Stitch''. ==Gallery== ===Screenshots=== L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 14.png L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 62.png L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 63.png L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats 34.png L&S - 2x23A - Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats.jpg Leroy & Stitch - Experiments at Aloha Stadium.png Leroy & Stitch - Experiments notice Hämsterviel high atop airlock.png Leroy & Stitch - GACC ship arriving at Aloha Stadium.png Leroy & Stitch - The gang arrives at Aloha Stadium.png Leroy & Stitch - 'Gantu turned from bad to good.'.png Leroy & Stitch - Experiments with Timon & Pumbaa cameos.png Leroy & Stitch - Stitch rolling over to his cousins.png Vlcsnap-2012-08-02-19h09m34s44.png Vlcsnap-2013-07-05-15h57m52s45.png Leroy & Stitch - Experiments in audience.png ===Miscellaneous=== 566 - Derrick.png Groupphoto.jpg The Origin Of Stitch Derrick.jpg|Misidentified as Experiment 136 (Gloomy) panes82.jpg ==External links== *{{L&S|Derrick (566)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Pets]]
