He is designed to consume metal in vast amounts and grow exponentially larger with all that he eats. He was captured by [[Gantu]], but was rescued in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]". ==Background== ===Personality=== Tank is a giant experiment whose intimidating nature only grows with his size. He is shown to be extremely insatiable and voracious, having an enormous appetite for metal. He will hurt anyone who gets in his way and can hold a grudge against them, like he did with [[Stitch]], but otherwise ignores individuals who run from him. ===Physical appearance=== Tank is a round, quadrupedal, orange armadillo/bulldog-like experiment with thick legs, black eyes, a brown oval nose, a large, wide mouth, sharp metal-like teeth, a short tail, two small ears, and plates going from the front of his head to the end of his tail. ===Powers and abilities=== Tank has exponential jaw strength that enables him to chew any type of metal with ease. His overbite jaw is also able to stretch amazingly, allowing him to eat things many times his size (such as a factory); he was able to eat an automobile bumper many times his length without struggle. His body size increases exponentially with any metal he consumes. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 586 was the 586th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to consume metal and grow exponentially bigger with each feast. 586 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 586's pod landing in a car's grille. When the owner washed down his car with a hose, 586's pod got wet, activating the experiment. 586 then ate the driver's automobile, leaving only the rubber tires, and ran off. Later, 586 devoured a huge factory that was being shown to some tourists riding in a van, then proceeded to eat metal throughout [[Kokaua Town|town]] until he grew to a large enough size to go on a rampage. [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] had been informed about 586 and realized he couldn't possibly catch the experiment in a [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]], due to how large it had grown. He then prepared the cargo bay of [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]] for abducting 586. Meanwhile, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] won tickets to the Elizabethan Fair and invited [[Elena, Teresa, and Yuki|the hula girls]] (who ditched [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] when she refused to participate with Lilo), but neglected [[Stitch]] after he told her an experiment was running amok. Later, Stitch (who couldn't attend the fair because no dogs were admitted) teamed up with a lonely Mertle in hopes of stopping 586. Stitch and Mertle evaded the gigantic 586 in [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]]'s [[X-Buggy|dune buggy]] after he got distracted from his metal-eating feast. After a while, a tractor beam abducted Stitch and Mertle into Gantu's ship. Though Gantu was briefly discouraged that he failed to capture 586, he locked Stitch and Mertle in teleport chambers and prepared to try again. [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] was inexplicably fascinated by Mertle. She used this to her advantage by soft-soaping Reuben, who released her from containment as a result. Mertle then locked Reuben in the teleport chamber, and after she freed Stitch from the adjacent one, they escaped the ship as well as 586's clutches. Gantu later chased down 586 in his ship, but the former was thwarted by Lilo, who brought down Gantu's ship and had two jugglers halt his progress. Meanwhile, Stitch attempted to battle 586, but the latter's enormous size rendered him impossible to defeat, despite Stitch's best efforts. Seeing that Stitch was outmatched by 586, Lilo turned to Gantu for help. 586's rampage continued to spread, where, after an attack on Stitch, he was abducted by a tractor beam from Gantu's ship, since Lilo had convinced Gantu earlier to get the humongous experiment away from Stitch. Mertle later reunited with the hula girls, who agreed to take her back if they could play dolls less often, and Lilo made amends with Stitch. Presumably after this, 586, named Tank, was sent to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] who somehow found a way to shrink him back to his normal size and confine him in a container. Although Tank was unseen in "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", he is known to have been sent back to Gantu along with all of Hämsterviel's other captive experiments after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused chaos and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. Tank reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by Lilo, Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission. Tank even helped with the escape by eating Gantu's [[Plasma Blaster|gun]] after [[Plasmoid]] broke it in two with a plasma blast. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Tank, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Tank participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by eating attacking Leroys. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Tank was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'' in the experiment gallery. *Tank is not referred to by his new name at any point in [[Tank (episode)|his debut]], but his name officially appears on the experiments list in the end credits of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. *Tank, along with [[Gigi]], [[Dorkifier]], [[Nosox]], [[Experiments#2-Series: Technological and scientific|Butter]], [[Shortstuff]], [[Spike (Lilo & Stitch)|Spike]], [[Yang]], [[Richter]], [[Phoon]], [[Splodyhead]], and one [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Leroy & Stitch|unconfirmed experiment]], are the only known experiments that are primarily quadrupeds. *Tank's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue. *The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Tank as: "Experiment 586. Primary function: Metal consumption. Experiment grows exponentially larger with everything it eats." *Tank has shrunk from a massive size back to his normal size between his debut and "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", suggesting he returns to his normal size after a while without eating any metal. *Tank is one of the few experiments to not have his one true place revealed. *In ''Leroy & Stitch'', Tank was seen in a larger form during the battle between the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy army]] and the experiments. It can be assumed that Tank was in a place where he had consumed metal. **Also during the battle, Tank is shown eating several Leroy clones, though it is unknown whether or not this actually killed the clones. *Tank's ability to grow larger from eating metal is similar to [[Ploot]]'s ability to grow larger from eating garbage and [[Fudgy]]'s ability to grow larger from eating chocolate in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. *Tank appears in the online game ''[[Lilo & Stitch: Alien Interception]]'', along with [[Clyde (Lilo & Stitch)|Clyde]], [[Dupe]], Yang, [[Plasmoid]], and [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. ==External links== *{{L&S|Tank (586)|Tank}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Tank}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Giants]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]]
Woops:
{{Infobox character |image = Profile - Woops.png |films = ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]'' |shows = ''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]'' |voice = [[Jeff Bennett]] |inspiration = [[Stitch]] |alias = Experiment 600 |occupation = Jumba's 600th experiment
Bowler |home = [[Hawaii]] |likes = Knocking things over, picking his nose, bowling, saying "Woops!" |dislikes = Being abandoned or contained |powers = All the same powers of [[Stitch]], but is too clumsy and causes accidental destruction |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Woops''', also known as '''Experiment 600''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is one of the failed prototypes of [[Stitch]], possessing all the same powers, but turned out to be a real klutz; he accidentally knocks over and/or breaks anything he touches and only says, "Woops!" after doing so, hence his name. His one true place is at Kokaua Town Lanes as a champion bowler on [[Pleakley]]'s bowling team, the Kokaua Bowling Brawlers. ==Background== ===Personality=== Woops is a very clumsy, accident-prone, and unbalanced experiment. He is easily guilty but never mourns over past accidents or incidents. He apologizes as often as he falls, and his personality is rather clownish and dim-witted. He is usually seen swaying side to side, laughing awkwardly, and picking his nose with his finger. He is left-footed and can get upset if abandoned or contained for periods of time. An amiable sort, Woops merely wants to do the right thing but just can't seem to do it. He can hardly seem to stand on his own two feet, let alone keep his balance, and is always running into objects and knocking them over. Most individuals find him unbearably annoying, but he is a bowling champion. ===Physical appearance=== Woops physically resembles Stitch, but with different body proportions. His body is bean-shaped, and he has long, thick limbs, an overbite exposing yellow buckteeth, a large Adam's-apple, a football-shaped head, a huge, bulbous nose, and three short pale mint green-tipped antennae and a tail. His ears and eyes are smaller than Stitch's. ===Powers and abilities=== Woops has all the powers of Stitch, including super-strength and durability, but he is too clumsy and unbalanced to use them. As a result, he unintentionally destroys everything around him. He is skilled at bowling (one of the few things where knocking stuff over is a ''good'' thing). ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 600 was the 600th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed for [[Stitch]]'s purpose, being indestructible and capable of anything, but was instead a destructive klutz who did nothing except break everything in his path. 600 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture Experiment 626. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 600's pod was found by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] and sent to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. When the latter discovered that 600 was a prototype of [[Stitch]], Hämsterviel activated the experiment. However, he and the captive experiments were awestruck by 600's klutzy behavior around the [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison]], which alerted the [[UGF Troopers|guards]] and almost blew Hämsterviel's cover in the process. As a result, Hämsterviel was forced to teleport 600 and the other captive experiments back to Earth on [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]], with orders to get rid of 600, as he gave Hämsterviel a headache, and to hold on to the other experiments until Hämsterviel was clear to hold them captive in his prison cell again. Meanwhile, 600's clumsiness around the ship ruined Gantu's azaleas, broke his [[Plasma Blaster|blaster]], and freed [[Nosy]] from [[Prison Capsule|containment]], allowing him to escape. Eventually, the mayhem caused by 600's clumsiness drove Gantu crazy enough to offer him to [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and Stitch. 600 was then taken in and named Woops by Lilo. Though initially dismayed by the clumsy experiment, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] discreetly suggested bringing Woops to [[Pleakley]]'s domino tournament (in a quite evil voice). However, upon seeing Woops, Pleakley panicked and then demanded Lilo to lock the klutz away until the tournament was over. Inside a containment orb at the [[Lilo's House|Pelekai residence]], Woops just so happened to sneeze, causing a chain reaction that transported him onto the streets of [[Kokaua Town]]. He soon started to bounce toward the dominoes. Just before impact, Stitch caught Woops and then let the latter out of his container. Woops suddenly sneezed again, which caused Stitch to stagger backward into the [[Ice Cream Man]], causing the ice cream from his cone to hit the dominoes, much to Pleakley's horror. Towards the end of the domino toppling, a startled cat hit a trash can, causing another chain reaction of objects hitting each other until the [[Kilauea Lighthouse|old lighthouse]] was destroyed, plummeting into the ocean. The events caused Lilo to discover that Woops was good at knocking things over (thanks to his clumsiness), and the latter found his one true place at the local bowling alley as a talented bowler (one of the few things where knocking stuff over is ''good'') on Pleakley's bowling team, the Kokaua Bowling Brawlers. In "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", Nosy revealed to Lilo and Stitch that Woops blew the secret about Hämsterviel's captive experiments, so he sent them all back to Gantu. Nosy then added that he got lucky because his container broke thanks to Woops. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Woops, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Woops participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], but it is unknown what he did. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Woops is the first known prototype of Stitch and is a massive failure. **Despite being a failure, Woops did help Stitch more than most other [[experiments]]: by freeing [[Nosy]], he started the chain of events seen in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", which ended up with Lilo and Stitch saving all the other 17 experiments imprisoned by Hämsterviel, including [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]], whom Stitch was feeling the most guilt for letting her be captured by Gantu and shipped to Hämsterviel. Ironically, Woops never met Angel (due to Angel somehow not appearing in Woops' [[Woops (episode)|debut episode]]). *Unlike most experiments, Woops' number is pronounced as a whole number ("six hundred") instead of three individual digits (which in his case would have been "six-oh-oh") as per the norm for the experiments. **The only other experiment seen in [[Lilo & Stitch: The Series|the original series]] whose number is also referred to as a whole number is [[Spooky]] (Experiment 300). This implies that experiments whose number is divisible by one hundred (100) are the primary exceptions to the normal by-digit pronunciation of experiment numbers. *Woops' [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue. *Woops is one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. *Woops' design bears a great resemblance to [[w:c:iceage:Sid|Sid]] from the ''{{WikipediaLink|Ice Age (franchise)|Ice Age}}'' films. Coincidentally, [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] currently owns the ''Ice Age'' franchise following the studio's acquisition of [[20th Century Studios|20th Century Fox]] in [[2019]]. ==External links== *{{L&S|Woops (600)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]]

He is designed to use his kickboxing and wrestling skills to bully and defeat opponents in hand-to-hand combat. His one true place is teaching people kickboxing and hosting his own workout video entitled ''Kickboxing with Kixx''. ==Background== ===Personality=== Kixx is shown to be a talented kickboxer and he loves to pick fights, which would consider him a bully. He also appears to be extremely hotheaded and violent. However, after [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] befriended him, Kixx has shown to control his temper a lot better. Despite his aggression, Kixx is loyal to those who win his trust. He is valiant and an excellent fighter, but also a really big softie deep down. He enjoys kickboxing, wrestling, and baseball and shows a sign of pride. ===Physical appearance=== Kixx is a purple, brawny [[w:c:looneytunes:Tasmanian Devil|Tasmanian Devil]]-like experiment with a lavender stomach, chest, ear insides, and spots around his eyes. He has four strong gorilla-like arms with three fingers on each paw and a blue oval spot on each elbow. His legs are significantly smaller and stubbier than his arms, and his head and mouth seem to connect straight to his chest, as there is hardly any neck. ===Powers and abilities=== Kixx possesses immense superhuman strength to the degree he is able to overpower Stitch one-on-one. While he lacks some intelligence, Kixx has a repertoire of kickboxing and wrestling techniques he can employ with his four arms, primarily in hand-to-hand combat. Like Stitch, Kixx can roll into a ball. Similar to [[Deforestator]], he can spin into a tornado to deliver consecutive punches to his opponent and is extremely fast when doing so. In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, it is also revealed that Kixx has a samurai style of fighting after being transmutated by [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 601 was the 601st experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hamsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to use his kickboxing and wrestling skills to beat up and defeat enemies. 601 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 601's pod landing by a cliff face. When a dehydrated tourist traveling with his wife tossed a half-full water bottle he drank from over the cliff, it landed by a ravine and trickled out, which touched 601's pod, activating the experiment. 601 then attacked [[Charles and Mary|the aforementioned couple]], beating them up when the husband angered him while mistaking him for a wild purple pig. Later, when [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] arrived to find and capture 601 (who had proceeded to attack and beat up other tourists), the latter ambushed them. Stitch prepared to fight 601, but due to an earlier snack combo incident in which Stitch's combat training was erased, he faltered. Lilo was then forced to retreat with Stitch, while 601 was distracted with beating up the newly arrived [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]. While 601 most likely continued his rampage, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] lent Lilo several books, including one entitled ''Fighting Four-Armed Monsters'', to help her re-train and condition Stitch to fight in combat. After practicing and mastering a few training exercises, Stitch was practically ready to battle 601 hand-to-hand. Meanwhile, 601 attacked [[Muscle Bay]], defeating all the boxers with ease. Stitch then came to challenge 601 to a rematch, and a long-drawn-out battle ensued between them. At first, 601 was able to easily overpower Stitch, but with Lilo's tutoring and Stitch's coordination, the latter easily defeated 601, who was restrained with ropes. 601, christened Kixx, shortly after found his one true place teaching other people kickboxing. Back at [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]], [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] and an injured Gantu watched a commercial of Kixx hosting his own instructional workout video on the ex-captain's TV set. It motivated Gantu to learn kickboxing after being pummeled by Kixx. Kixx reappeared in "[[Elastico (episode)|Elastico]]" as one of the audience members for Lilo's hula dance. In "[[The Asteroid]]", Kixx was one of the six experiments that Stitch convinced to come with him and Lilo to save Earth from an approaching asteroid. Along the journey, Kixx kicked the back of [[Spooky]]'s seat, causing the latter (using his nightmarish morphing ability) to terrify him. Also, when Kixx grabbed at the free refreshments, only to get slapped by [[Pleakley]], the former beat Pleakley up and then took a bag of peanuts for himself. He later endured a clobbering from [[Hammerface]] and helped Stitch remove the [[Jumba's Ship|ship]]'s hyperdrive engine. Kixx made a brief cameo in "[[Houdini (episode)|Houdini]]" on Gantu's TV set continuing his broadcast of his recent kickboxing commercial. In "[[Angel (episode)|Angel]]", Kixx was one of the experiments that [[Angel (Lilo & Stitch)|Angel]] reverted to evil using her song, causing the former to beat up athletes and forcing Stitch to fight and defeat him again. Later, Kixx and the other depraved experiments attacked Stitch aboard a ship, but Angel turned them to good again before Kixx could land the fatal blow. Working together, the experiments were then able to successfully escape the ship with Stitch. Kixx reappeared in "[[Slugger (episode)|Slugger]]" as part of Lilo's softball team. In "[[Shoe (episode)|Shoe]]", Kixx was one of the experiments that helped turn Jumba's ship into a [[Jumba & Pleakley's Bed & Not Breakfast|hotel]]. Kixx was one of the experiments in "[[Checkers (episode)|Checkers]]" that joined Stitch in a rebellion against Gantu. Although he did not appear during the battle, he was seen rebuilding the float after Gantu's defeat. In "[[Ploot (episode)|Ploot]]", Kixx was one of the first team of experiments (along with [[Deforestator]] and [[Richter]]) formed to try and stop [[Ploot]]. However, Ploot was easily able to defeat them, forcing the three experiments to retreat. Kixx was seen on a computer screen in "[[Ace (episode)|Ace]]", posing as an evil creation of Jumba's as part of a hoax to fool [[Mortlegax]], the head of E.G.O. industries. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Kixx, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Kixx participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by beating up attacking Leroys. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. Kixx joins them for the song by playing the congas. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Kixx made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime, along with [[Pix]], [[Boomer (Lilo & Stitch)|Boomer]], [[Slushy]], [[Blowhard]], and [[Slugger]], when [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] and [[Stitch]] visited [[Tokyo Disneyland]]. He made a second appearance where [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] modified him with a new samurai style of fighting, along with a samurai outfit to match it. After being defeated, Kixx was presumably reverted back to normal, then dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Kixx wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. He later appeared in the special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Kixx was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! Swimming underwater |paraphernalia = Dorsal fin |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")|rides=[[Stitch Encounter]] (cameo)}} '''Sinker''', also known as '''Experiment 602''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed sink entire naval fleets with his long, razor-sharp dorsal fin; he can hold his breath underwater indefinitely to carry out his primary function. His one true place is at a [[Japan]]ese restaurant, cutting up fish fillets and vegetables to make sushi. ==Background== ===Personality=== Sinker has a knack for cutting and slicing things in half with his long dorsal fin. He is shown to be greatly offended by the mocking of his size compared to the rest of him. He is also incredibly territorial in that he will claim an entire body of water and remain there until he has sunk every vessel in the area. ===Physical appearance=== Sinker is a small purple shark-like experiment with small dark red eyes, a thin mouth with a turquoise tongue, small arms and legs, and a large, sword-like dorsal fin. ===Powers and abilities=== Sinker can use his large, razor dorsal fin to slice sea vessels up to the size of a yacht in two. He can also use his dorsal fin like a knife to cut up and chop food. He can swim underwater like a shark and is capable of holding his breath indefinitely, indicating that he has lungs instead of gills. ===Weaknesses=== In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, it is revealed that Sinker has a blind spot on his large dorsal fin and will become immobile on land if forced into a horizontal position. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 602 was the 602nd genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to slice enemy sea vessels in two with his large, sword-like dorsal fin. 602 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. At an unknown point after this, Experiment 602 was activated. When [[Keoni Jameson|Keoni]] was practicing for an upcoming boat race, 602 sunk his boat while [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] were watching. Later, when Lilo and Stitch attempted to capture 602, the latter proceeded to sink their [[X-Buggy|motorboat]] as well. When [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] tried to go and rescue them, 602 sunk their raft too. 602, named Sinker, then proceeded to sink [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] and [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] numerous times when they attempted to catch the former, and likely sunk other watercraft. Later, Lilo, Stitch, Jumba, and Pleakley stowed away aboard a cruise ship, where Lilo tried to warn the captain about Sinker's rampage, to no avail. However, they got caught and thrown in the brig due to Stitch's horseplay. After the four managed to break out, Jumba hatched a plan to capture Sinker. Wearing scuba gear (and defying his aquaphobia), Stitch dove underwater to look for Sinker, while the latter retreated to a cave until he eventually came out, revealing the diminutive size of his body. However, Sinker was unamused after Stitch laughed at the former's puny size. As he escaped, Stitch chased after Sinker and was able to grab hold of his large dorsal fin. While swimming through the ocean, Sinker sunk a fishing boat where two fishermen were using a net to catch fish. He then attempted to sink the runaway cruise ship, but Stitch managed to capture Sinker in the ship's anchor and chain. Shortly after, Sinker found his one true place at a sushi restaurant, cutting up fish fillets and vegetables with his elongated dorsal fin. In "[[Drowsy (episode)|Drowsy]]", Sinker's picture was seen in [[Lilo's Experiment Book|Lilo's experiment logbook]]. In "[[Ploot (episode)|Ploot]]", Lilo tried to convince Sinker to help her defeat [[Ploot]], but he was unable to because he was very busy cutting up food for a large party while Hatha, the other chef who worked there, called in sick. In "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", Sinker's picture was seen in Lilo's experiment logbook again. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== In the film's opening, Sinker can be seen popping his head out of the water and waving hello to [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Sinker, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Sinker participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]]. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Sinker made a cameo appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime as an image on a computer screen and as one of the experiments in [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison cell]]. He made another appearance along with [[Slushy]], in which Hämsterviel used both of them to attack a cruise ship that he had lured [[Stitch]] onto. It is also revealed that Sinker is capable of speaking fluently and has a blind spot on his dorsal fin. Thus, he will become immobile if forced into a horizontal position because of his large fin. After being defeated, Sinker was reverted back to normal, then dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Sinker wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. He later appeared in the special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Sinker is an obvious parody of [[w:c:villains:Great White Sharks (Jaws)|the titular great white shark]] from ''{{WikipediaLink|Jaws (film)|Jaws}}''. *Sinker was activated off-screen. *Sinker is one of the rare experiments to not have black eyes like most experiments, having dark red eyes instead. *Sinker's dorsal fin is shown to have differences in size, though it is likely a continuity error. *Despite being an aquatic-based experiment, Sinker has no gills and appears to be unable to breathe underwater, yet is able to hold his breath indefinitely. *Sinker is one of the few experiments to not appear in the group photo at the end of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. *Sinker's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. ==External links== *{{L&S|Sinker (602)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Sea monsters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Marine animals]] [[Category:Sharks]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Chefs]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]]

Telekinesis |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Houdini''', also known as '''Experiment 604''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to make armies and weapons invisible; unfortunately, he was gun-shy on the battlefield and always ran away and made himself invisible instead. His one true place is as a [[Hollywood]] star magician, but his actions have promoted him to a shark tank attraction, where he makes sharks disappear to amaze crowds. ==Background== ===Personality=== Unlike the initial behavior of most experiments, Houdini has no destructive intent; on the contrary, he is a very timid and easily frightened experiment. He is shown to be scared by almost everything, suggesting he has {{WikipediaLink|panphobia}}. He is also easily intimidated and startled by loud noises. It took a tremendous effort for him to leave show biz to help out his cousin [[Stitch]], and even then he typically stays invisible 95% of the time. ===Physical appearance=== Houdini is a petite, cream-colored rabbit-like experiment. He has huge beady black eyes and even larger ears, but a small mouth with a tooth sticking out. His body has four brown spots on each elbow and knee, light pink markings around his eyes, chest, and stomach, dark pink stripes on his arms and legs, and purple markings on his back and ear tips. ===Powers and abilities=== Houdini can instantly render anything, including himself, invisible with a blink of his massive eyes, but can also make them reappear by blinking again. Houdini can choose whatever he wants to make invisible by looking at the target. However, his eyes are highly sensitive to camera flashes, as one flash temporarily blinds him, forcing him to blink repeatedly to try to get his vision back, and ends up making random things invisible due to the fact that he cannot see what he is doing. His invisibility also does not hide his body temperature, meaning he can be detected by infrared vision. In "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", Houdini is shown to have some {{WikipediaLink|Psychokinesis|telekinesis}} or at least street magic while performing to a crowd by levitating a card. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 604 was the 604th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to render entire armies and weapons invisible, but due to being cowardly, he instead kept turning himself invisible and fleeing the battlefield. 604 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. On a small outdoor stage, [[Stitch]] and [[Pleakley]] rehearsed a magic act in front of [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], and a few experiments for [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]'s upcoming half birthday, but Stitch kept bungling the act with his failed tricks. When Lilo realized that Stitch was having trouble, she asked Jumba if he had any experiments that could help with Stitch's magic act. Jumba then took out 604's pod, but warned that 604 had cowardly habits. Using a leash as a restraint, Lilo activated 604 and named him Houdini, but the craven experiment panicked and made himself invisible until Lilo pacified him. She then trained Houdini to turn things invisible upon hearing "Alakablooe" and vice versa upon hearing "Alakazoo" with a blink of his eyes. During Mertle's party, Houdini secretly helped Stitch out with his magic act. However, the former was eventually caught in the act by Mertle, who photographed Houdini. The camera flash spooked him, thus causing Houdini to turn Stitch and numerous other things invisible, including himself. Before Houdini became invisible, [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], who was looking for the experiment, spied on Stitch's magic act and spotted Houdini. However, when Gantu crashed the party in an attempt to nab Houdini, the latter escaped in fear. Mertle later visited [[Lilo's House|Lilo's house]] and condemned her for being a fraud before revealing the photo taken of Houdini. To make matters worse, [[Mrs. Edmonds]] had booked [[Stacy Edmonds|Mertle's aunt]] and her staff to witness Stitch's magic act. Lilo knew that Stitch was unable to do magic without Houdini's help. While Stitch was invisible, Lilo adorned him in different ways so that she could still see him before they searched for Houdini. Later, Gantu, wearing special infrared heat goggles, pursued an invisible Houdini through a jungle. However, the latter was able to slow Gantu down by turning palm trees and other obstacles invisible. Before long, Houdini bumped into an invisible Stitch. The collision caused Lilo to touch what she thought was Stitch (but was actually an invisible Houdini) and drag him into a bush with her. Thus, Gantu ended up [[Prison Capsule|capturing]] what he thought was Houdini (but was actually an invisible Stitch), which he took back to [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]]. Lilo later revealed to Jumba and Pleakley that Stitch couldn't do magic at all, and when she uttered the magic word for making things reappear, Houdini made himself visible again. Lilo then realized that Gantu must have grabbed Stitch by mistake. When Pleakley scolded Houdini, the latter turned invisible out of fright and fled. Meanwhile, an invisible Stitch began trashing stuff inside Gantu's ship, making Gantu and [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] suspicious. The former then fired his [[Plasma Blaster|plasma gun]] repeatedly in an attempt to subdue the invisible experiment. After a brief struggle, Stitch managed to escape the ship and reunite with Lilo. Eventually, she and Stitch recaptured Houdini after a long chase. While the staff booed Pleakley for stalling them with his promised magic act, Lilo and Stitch arrived with Houdini, who then made the [[Kilauea Lighthouse|old lighthouse]] disappear, much to Pleakley's relief. The crowd cheered, although when Lilo then revealed Houdini to them, the people became intrigued and began taking flash photos of the experiment, causing him to make everything on Kauai disappear. Shortly after, Houdini found his one true place in [[Hollywood]] as a star magician. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Houdini was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream, but he is barely seen behind [[Thresher]] and in front of [[627]]. Houdini reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", performing a magic act to a crowd by levitating a playing card using telekinesis. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Houdini, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. In the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], Houdini evaded attacking Leroys by turning himself invisible. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Houdini made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime, along with [[Frenchfry]], [[Squeak]], [[Pix]], and [[Tickle-Tummy]] after [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] kicked them out for being considered useless. Houdini also appeared in the special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Houdini is named after the famous [[Hollywood]] magician [[Harry Houdini]]. *Houdini is shown to be easily scared by almost everything, suggesting he has {{WikipediaLink|panphobia}}. *Houdini is one of the few known experiments whose powers Stitch is vulnerable to. *Houdini's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is yellow. *Houndi is the first experiment to have magic powers. *The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Houdini as: "Experiment 604. He is designed to transform into a matter-sucking black hole that can destroy entire galaxies. His one true place is sucking up construction debris and litter. ==Background== ===Personality=== Despite his destructive and chaotic function, Holio has an eerily calm nature when he is not acting as a black hole. This is deceptive at first glance, for behind his harmless appearance belies his more chaotic abilities. When not using his powers, Holio is very compliant with demands and eager to help clean up debris as his one true place. He is also shown to be loyal and helpful to his friends, joining [[Stitch]]'s rebellion to fight off [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]. ===Physical appearance=== Holio is a small red, chipmunk-like experiment with a large mouth with two teeth sticking out. He has a pink stomach from his chin down, black pupil-less eyes, dark pink nose, two thin antennae, and three thin back spines. ===Powers and abilities=== Holio can flip and turn into a matter-sucking black hole, which can destroy an entire galaxy, at will. He can also become a subdued version of this to devour things through his mouth, which can have a weaker yet similar effect as his black hole form. ===Weaknesses=== [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s anti-antimatter sphere can destroy Holio's black hole. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 606 was the 606th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to create a matter-sucking black hole capable of sucking in entire planets. 606 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 606's pod eventually made its way to a jewelry maker, who attached the pod to a bracelet as a charm. An elderly vendor fashioned and sold the bracelet to [[Mrs. Edmonds]], which she bought as a birthday present for her daughter, [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], neither one aware of what one of the trinkets attached to the bracelet actually was. During Mertle's birthday party, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] pulled a harmless prank on Mertle and [[Elena, Teresa, and Yuki|the hula girls]]. Lilo then noticed 606's pod on Mertle's bracelet and tried to take it from her, only to get in trouble with Mrs. Edmonds and [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]]. Later, Stitch went undercover as a bunny at a pet shop, where he inspected the pod number on Mertle's bracelet and messaged Lilo via walkie-talkie. When she looked up 606 and learned about the latter's powers, she fell into despair but got arrested for being in [[Officer Kahiko]]'s police car (though Stitch busted Lilo out). Despite Lilo and Stitch's best efforts to steal Mertle's bracelet, when she noticed that Lilo was desperate to stop 606's pod from getting wet, Mertle took it back to [[Mertle's House|her house]]. There, out of curiosity, she dropped the bracelet into a glass of water, getting the pod wet and activating 606. The experiment then transformed into a black hole, which began to suck up everything in Mertle's bedroom. After a while, the hole expanded beyond Mertle's room and started sucking up the entire [[Kokaua Town|town]]. Mertle eventually telephoned Lilo to complain about the massive destruction that 606 was causing. Fortunately, Lilo and Stitch (with some of [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s assistance) were able to enter the black hole in Nani's [[X-Buggy|dune buggy]] and throw an anti-antimatter sphere into the center of the hole, causing it to begin to collapse. Lilo and Stitch managed to narrowly escape the black hole, which released everything that was sucked in except for Mertle's dolls. She then demanded her dolls back from 606, who complied by releasing the countless dolls through his mouth on top of Mertle. Shortly after, 606, named Holio, found his one true place sucking up construction debris while repairs were made to the [[Rental Hut]] that had been nearly destroyed by said black hole. Holio was one of the experiments in "[[Checkers (episode)|Checkers]]" that joined Stitch in a rebellion against [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]]. Holio even tried to suck [[Checkers]] off Gantu's head, but he instead sucked off the ex-captain's clothes, leaving him nude. Holio was seen on a computer screen in "[[Ace (episode)|Ace]]", posing as an evil creation of Jumba's as part of a hoax to fool [[Mortlegax]], the head of E.G.O. industries. Holio was briefly seen in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", creating a black hole to suck litter off the streets. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Holio, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Holio did not participate in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]], instead choosing to retreat with the weaker experiments. The Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe, during which Holio can be seen around some of the Leroys as they started to shut down. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Holio was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'' in the experiment gallery. *Holio is not referred to by his new name at any point in [[Holio (episode)|his debut]], but his name officially appears on the experiments list in the end credits of ''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''. *In his debut episode, Holio has no tail, but in "[[Checkers (episode)|Checkers]]", when he and the other experiments jump ashore, he is seen with a stumpy tail. *Holio's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is blue. *In ''Leroy & Stitch'', Holio did not choose to participate in the battle between the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy army]] and the experiments, which is ironic, considering the fact that he is one of the most powerful experiments. *Holio's head appears in the online game ''[[Jumba's Lab]]''. ==External links== *{{L&S|Holio (606)}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch characters]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Silent characters]] [[Category:Video game bosses]]

Flight |paraphernalia = Bat-like tail |status = Active |creator = [[Jumba Jookiba]] (creator) |family = [[Experiments]] ("cousins")}} '''Slugger''', also known as '''Experiment 608''', is an illegal [[Experiments|genetic experiment]] created by [[Jumba Jookiba]] and a character in the [[Lilo & Stitch (franchise)|''Lilo & Stitch'' franchise]]. He is designed to deflect incoming enemy projectiles and swat away balls, toys, and fruits thrown over the fence by annoying kids. His one true place is at the baseball field as a coaching assistant for Little League softball. ==Background== ===Personality=== Slugger is an adept baseball player who is actually stronger than he appears to be, as he was able to grip a basketball pole without any struggle and whack [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] over a vast distance. He will hit anything that comes his way on instinct due to his programming, but is also one of the least hostile among the other experiments. He seems cautious of people, but gets along quite well with others once he gets to know them. ===Physical appearance=== Slugger is a yellow [[Pteranodon|pterosaur]]-like experiment with an orange stripe running down his face, black eyes, a thin beak-like mouth, and a baseball bat-like tail. In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, he has teeth in his beak. ===Powers and abilities=== Slugger's bat-like tail can deflect incoming projectiles of almost any texture or substance, although he mainly uses this for deflecting baseballs. His tail can also rotate 360 degrees around his waist at high speeds. Slugger has amazing strength, absurd precision, and coordination, and is capable of flight. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 608 was the 608th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to deflect incoming enemy projectiles. 608 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 608's pod landing on a baseball field. 608's pod was mixed in with a bunch of softballs. When the team's Little League coach found it and realized it wasn't a softball, he tossed it. The pod landed into a drink cooler, the melting ice activating 608, who shivered from the chill. 608 then spotted a woman in a wheelchair throwing a ball for her dog to fetch. Before the dog could retrieve the ball, 608 deflected it with his bat-like tail, astounding the dog. Later, multiple coconuts thrown by [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] and deflected by 608 hit [[Stitch]] on the head, therefore grabbing his and [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s attention. Before they could react, [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived and grabbed 608 (even stating how weak the latter was as he struggled to get free). Just then, Stitch slammed a crate onto Gantu's head, and 608 got loose from his grasp. Afterwards, Lilo started talking to 608 and pacified him. When Lilo assured him that she and Stitch will keep him safe, they took 608, named Slugger, [[Lilo's House|home]] and discovered his incredible batting skills. Lilo then decided to put Slugger on her softball team, since [[Pleakley]] had jeopardized the previous game with his incompetence, and after Lilo and [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] had wagered a rematch. Thus, Slugger became Lilo's new softball player against Mertle's team. He did really well during practice until Mertle changed the game to basketball, put Gantu on her team, and even made Slugger be part of the wager. Slugger struggled at basketball because he was only able to hit things, but Lilo's team still won thanks to Stitch and a very talented Pleakley. Gantu, being a sore loser, attempted to make off with Slugger, but the latter was saved when Stitch tripped Gantu using one of the basketball goals. Enraged, Gantu ripped out the other basketball pole and prepared to retaliate. However, he was thwarted by Stitch, who then let Slugger use the pole to whack Gantu over a vast distance. Slugger later found his one true place as the new hitter for the Little League softball team, whose coach (the same one who activated Slugger earlier) wasn't a very good hitter himself. With Slugger coaching, the team would quickly become first place. Slugger reappeared in "[[Glitch (episode)|Glitch]]", coaching for the Little League team, when a baseball pitching machine went haywire while he was practicing his batting skills. Regardless, Slugger spun his bat-like tail around his body and deflected every softball the machine shot at him, causing the team's members to panic as they dodged the flurry of rapidly incoming balls. When the coach unplugged the machine to stop it, [[Glitch|223]]'s pod was shot out. Slugger gave it the biggest hit of all, sending it all the way to Lilo's house where it met its activation. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== Slugger was seen early in the movie coaching Little League softball with his batting skills as [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] was making her rounds with [[Scrump]] to make sure all the experiments were happy in the one true place they belonged. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Slugger, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Slugger participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by deflecting Leroys' plasma projectiles back at them. He also carried off a couple of Leroys with his bat-like tail. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Slugger made a cameo appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime as one of the experiments in [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison cell]]. He made another appearance, along with [[Pix]], [[Boomer (Lilo & Stitch)|Boomer]], [[Slushy]], [[Blowhard]], and [[Kixx]] when [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] and [[Stitch]] visited [[Tokyo Disneyland]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Slugger, [[Bugby]], [[Babyfier]], [[Jam]], [[Melty]], [[Wishy-Washy]], [[Snooty]], [[Amnesio]], [[Hunkahunka]], [[Experiments#5-Series: Elemental and environmental manipulators|Blake]], [[Witch (Lilo & Stitch)|Witch]], and two [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Comic Zone Volume 1: Disney's Lilo & Stitch|unconfirmed]] [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Miscellaneous|experiments]] are the only known experiments that have wings. *Despite Gantu claiming Slugger to be weak, he was able to grasp a basketball pole and whack Gantu over a vast distance without any struggle, and another time he suspended Stitch in mid-flight, again without any struggle. *Slugger is one of two known experiments whose [[Experiment Pods|pod]] got mixed up with some softballs, the other being [[Glitch]]. *Slugger's pod color is blue. *The [[Experiment Pod Container]] describes Slugger as: "Experiment 608. He is designed to fire orange heat lasers from the black oval-shaped bulb on his forehead. He was captured by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], but was rescued in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]". ==Background== ===Physical appearance=== Heat is an alien experiment that resembles a mix between a dog and a koala. He has small black eyes, thick arms and legs, a triangular nose, and a black oval on his forehead. His fur is red-orange while his underbelly is orange. ===Powers and abilities=== True to his name, Heat is able to shoot out beams of heat energy from the oval-shaped bulb on his head. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 609 was the 609th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to shoot orange heat rays from the large bulb on his forehead. 609 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 609's pod eventually made its way to a junk shop, where it (along with [[Hammerface|033]], [[Thresher|544]], and [[Plasmoid|617]]) was found, stolen, activated, and named Heat by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] in "[[Dupe (episode)|Dupe]]". Back at [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]], Gantu trained and conditioned Hammerface, Heat, Thresher, and Plasmoid by simply using [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] for target practice, much to his indignity and chagrin. The four henchmen experiments were then led by Gantu in an attack on the [[Lilo's House|Pelekais' house]], where their boss ordered them to defeat and capture [[Stitch]] and his duplicates after seeing that he had been split into four. Heat engaged one of the clones in a duel. The clone picked up the couch to use as a weapon, but as he only possessed one-fourth of the original Stitch's strength, picking it up was a struggle for him. Seeing his chance, Heat used his heat ray to carve a hole in the bottom of the couch, and due to the sudden imbalance, it collapsed on top of the clone. Gantu then picked the latter up and placed him in a [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]]. After capturing Stitch and his clones, the five returned to Gantu's ship for a victory feast (courtesy of Reuben), but were interrupted by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Pleakley]], and [[Dupe]]. When Lilo tricked Gantu into using Dupe's cloning ability, Gantu used Dupe to clone Heat into a hundred replicas. However, as the original Heat's power was divided among them, they all became complete weaklings, and thus were easily defeated. Presumably after this, they were all sent to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] who was somehow able to remerge the weakling Heat clones into the original. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Heat was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. Although Heat was unseen in "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", he is known to have been sent back to Gantu along with all of Hämsterviel's other captive experiments after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused chaos and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. Heat reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by Lilo, Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Heat, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]] and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Heat participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by firing heat lasers at attacking Leroys. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Heat made an appearance in a later episode of the ''Stitch!'' anime along with [[Swapper]], both of whom [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] used in another plot. Heat was mistaken for [[Splodyhead]] by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]. Swapper switched [[Stitch]] and [[Hiroman]]'s bodies. Then, when Heat attacked, Hiroman required to figure out how to use Stitch's abilities to win. After being defeated, Heat was presumably reverted back to normal, then dehydrated back into an experiment pod and stored in Jumba's vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Heat wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. She is designed to utilize supernatural forces in order to subdue and abduct planetary leaders. Her powers include intangibility, animation, and many other reality-bending abilities. She is capable of possessing individuals and channeling her powers through their vessel, but she can be forced out of her victim if she sees her reflection. She appears in the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime. ==Background== Experiment 610 was the 610th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. She was designed to use magic and reality-bending abilities to defeat and kidnap planetary leaders. 610 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. ===Physical appearance=== Witch is a purple bat/pikaia-like experiment. The back of her head is shaped like a cone and curved at the bottom to resemble a witch's hat, while her ears are small bat wings. She also has two wide arms resembling flippers and dark blue eyes with eyelashes. Her stomach is light purple and her chest has a yellow heart. She has a continuous wisp-like tail instead of legs, similar to [[Phantasmo]]. Her witch-like hat has a pattern of purple and then light purple stripes. She also has a yellow "H" on her forehead, which is a product of [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s transmutation process. ===Powers and abilities=== Witch was designed to have many supernatural abilities. Her powers include intangibility, animation, and various other reality-bending abilities. She is capable of possessing individuals and channeling her powers through their vessel. Once possessed, the victim is under Witch's complete control and also has her variety of abilities, such as animation, spontaneous generation, levitation, transformation, and other forms of reality-bending abilities. However, Witch can be forced out of her victim if she sees her reflection, much like how the evil creature {{WikipediaLink|Medusa}} was defeated in mythology. ==Appearances== ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== [[File:Desktop_7-30-2013_4-26-48_PM-791.jpg|thumb|right|Witch turning Jessica into an evil witch]]In her eponymous debut, [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] gained possession of Witch and reprogrammed her to be able to possess humans so as to enhance her abilities. Witch was sealed in a box and released when [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]] and [[Jessica (Stitch!)|Jessica]] opened it. She possessed Jessica afterwards and turned her into an evil witch. After a tough battle, Witch was surrounded with six mirrors, forcing her out of Jessica and into [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s capture container. When Witch turns Jessica into an evil witch, Jessica's hair turns gray and her eyes turn light purple. She also wears an orange dress with a small black jacket, as well as black gloves with black boots. [[File:Desktop_7-30-2013_4-32-43_PM-109.jpg|thumb|right|Witch turning Jessica into her demonic form]] When Witch transforms Jessica into her demonic form, her hair has a little more twist. Her arms and legs grow purple fur with claws. She now wears the black dress with an extra red skirt. This time, she grows a tail and bat-like wings. There is also a red color around her eyes. In "Shogun", it is shown that Witch was dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in Jumba's vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed her pod to help [[Stitch]] in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Witch wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. ==Trivia== *Witch is one of the rare experiments to not have black eyes like most experiments, having dark blue eyes instead. Interestingly, she shares this trait with [[Bonnie (Lilo & Stitch)|Bonnie]], [[Tickle-Tummy]], and [[Welko]], three other female experiments. **Witch is also one of the few experiments with visible irises. However, she was entirely under [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s control in her appearance. Since other experiments under Hämsterviel's possession in the [[Stitch!|anime]] tend to have their eyes diluted to show irises and/or sclerae, it is unknown whether or not Witch's own irises being visible is a result of Hämsterviel controlling her or if it's a natural part of her appearance. *Witch and [[Hertz Donut]] are the only two experiments that first appeared in ''Stitch!'', but were not shown in their original (un-transmutated) form and whose real eye color is unknown. *Witch, [[Bugby]], [[Babyfier]], [[Jam]], [[Melty]], [[Wishy-Washy]], [[Snooty]], [[Amnesio]], [[Hunkahunka]], [[Experiments#5-Series: Elemental and environmental manipulators|Blake]], [[Slugger]], and two [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Comic Zone Volume 1: Disney's Lilo & Stitch|unconfirmed]] [[Unconfirmed Experiments#Miscellaneous|experiments]] are the only known experiments that have wings. *Witch, [[Phantasmo]], [[Fudgy]], [[Remmy]], and Tickle-Tummy are the only known experiments to have arms but no legs. **Interestingly, excluding Fudgy, all of these experiments are capable of levitation. Remmy is always seen levitating. Phantasmo and Witch primarily levitate but often possess objects or living beings to move by other means. Tickle-Tummy is also able to levitate, but has been seen bouncing as well. *Witch, Phantasmo, and [[Glitch]] are all capable of possession, albeit in different capacities: Witch can possess living beings, Phantasmo can possess any inanimate object, and Glitch possesses technology. *Witch's [[Experiment Pods|pod]] color is green. *According to Jumba, Witch is the only experiment that can perform magic (witchcraft). ==Gallery== 610 - Witch.png Witch pod.jpg|Witch's experiment pod Profile - Witch (Lilo & Stitch).png screenCapture 19.02.13 0-19-37.jpg|試作品610号ウィッチ translates to Prototype No.610 Witch screenCapture 19.02.13 0-22-45.jpg Witchclass.png|Witch's powers of spontaneous generation Witchgirlbroom.png Witch2.png Witch3.png Witch4.png Witch5.png Witchtrans.png Witchwings.png Witchout.png|Witch being forced out of Jessica screenCapture 19.02.13 0-20-20.jpg screenCapture 19.02.13 0-22-13.jpg screenCapture 19.02.13 0-21-49.jpg ==External links== *{{L&S|Witch (610)|Witch}} {{Lilo & Stitch}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Witch}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Stitch! characters]] [[Category:Lilo & Stitch Experiments]] [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Aliens]] [[Category:Disney characters]] [[Category:Villains]] [[Category:Witches]] [[Category:Magic users]] [[Category:Animated characters]] [[Category:Shapeshifters]] [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Silent characters]]

He is designed to create devastating sonic blasts that can shatter windows, flatten buildings, and cause acute loss of hearing. Luckily, he can also reduce these noises to soft, gentle honks. His one true place is at [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]] as an alien invasion alarm and buzzer. ==Background== ===Personality=== Despite his destructive nature, Yaarp is quite friendly, but he reacts quickly and dramatically to the way others treat him. For example, if he feels intimidated or provoked, he will emit loud sonic blasts. If he feels safe or unthreatened, he will emit small, gentle honks as a sign of affection and friendship. Yaarp, for the most part, is pretty easygoing and laid-back. However, he is very ready-minded and cautious, but is loyal to those who win his trust. He is also a bit jumpy and nervous, often sounding his horn at improper times because something trivial had startled him. ===Physical appearance=== Yaarp is a small, turquoise/blue lemur-like experiment with four arms, small floppy [[Drowsy]]-like ears, and a foghorn-like antenna on his head. The antenna, the tips of his ears, and the single ring on his tail, as well as the tail's tip, are all blue. The area around his eyes, his muzzle and chest/belly, and his paw pads are all a lighter variant of his body color. ===Powers and abilities=== *'''Sonic Blast''': Yaarp can produce devastating sonic blasts through his megaphone-like antenna. These noises can range from small, gentle honks to massive shock waves that can shatter buildings and cause acute loss of hearing. *'''Bouncing Tail''': His tail can act like a spring, as he often bounces on it instead of using his limbs. *Yaarp has shown to be skilled in playing the foghorn-like device on his head like a trumpet. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 613 was the 613th experiment to be created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to use his sonic-blasting ability to cause massive damage and deafen nearby victims. 613 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai, with 613's pod landing in [[Mrs. Hasagawa]]'s [[Hasagawa Fruits|fruit stand]]. When Mrs. Hasagawa watered her fruit, 613's pod got wet, activating the experiment. After being admired by [[Charles and Mary|a couple]] on their honeymoon, 613 then proceeded to cause massive chaos using his destructive shock waves. Later, when [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], wearing special earmuffs, chased 613 into an electronics store, the latter was captured in a [[Prison Capsule|container]], but rescued and freed by [[Stitch]]. Instead of showing gratitude, 613 emitted a sonic blast that made Stitch go temporarily deaf, then fled the store with Gantu in hot pursuit. Since Stitch's ears were highly sensitive to 613's shock waves, [[Pleakley]] was chosen for the task, as he did not have ears and was therefore unaffected by the sound blasts. After [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], Stitch, and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] attempted to train and condition Pleakley, he was equipped with special experiment catching gear. The four tracked 613 down to a cave, where Stitch, using a conch, posed as the experiment and acted like a decoy. He then imitated 613's sonic blast to alert Gantu, who donned his earmuffs and pursued Stitch. Meanwhile, a reluctant Pleakley entered the cave, where he discovered 613. When Pleakley unintentionally blasted 613 with a vacuum, the latter retaliated using a massive shock wave. However, when a sudden cave-in endangered 613's life, he was then saved by Pleakley. 613 gratefully kissed him three times, while Pleakley christened him Yaarp. Pleakley and Yaarp soon fled the crumbling cave and made it out safely. When Yaarp first noticed Lilo, he growled until Pleakley assured him that she was a friend, causing Yaarp to emit a gentle honk. Unfortunately, Stitch got captured by Gantu (who thought Stitch was actually Yaarp) during the process, and the latter demanded a ransom exchange. As part of a setup, Lilo arrived at the local museum with Yaarp in a pet carrier, where the former made Gantu believe that Yaarp was rehabilitated. However (as planned), when Gantu removed his earmuffs and bartered the captive Stitch for Yaarp, the latter unleashed a sonic blast upon Lilo's signal, alerting the authorities and forcing Gantu to flee. After Lilo revealed Yaarp to the [[Mayor Anolo|mayor]] and [[Nicolé|chairwoman]], he was given a one true place as an alien invasion alarm at Lilo's [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]]. Yaarp reappeared in "[[Elastico (episode)|Elastico]]" as one of the audience members for Lilo's hula dance. In "[[Spike (episode)|Spike]]", Yaarp served as the scorekeeper for the Ohana-Rama, and was also briefly seen hiding under the couch during Pleakley's E.A.R.W.A.X. session. In "[[Remmy (episode)|Remmy]]", Yaarp was one of the experiments in Lilo's dream. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== In the film's opening Yaarp can be seen greeting [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] with sonic blasts from his megaphone-like antenna. Later, the first 624 experiments, including Yaarp, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, Lilo, [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Yaarp participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by presumably using his sonic blasts to deafen and push Leroys back. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. Yaarp joins them for the song by playing the built-in foghorn-like device on his head. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Yaarp made an appearance in the ''Stitch!'' anime special ''Stitch and the Planet of Sand''. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Yaarp was first revealed in a DVD bonus feature of ''[[Stitch! The Movie]]'' in the experiment gallery. *Yaarp is one of the few known experiments whose powers Stitch is vulnerable to. *Yaarp is one of the ten known experiments named by someone other than Lilo or Stitch, the other nine being [[Gigi]], [[Elastico]], [[Hammerface]], [[Heat]], [[Thresher]], [[Plasmoid]], [[Morpholomew]], [[Shrink]], and [[Leroy]]. **Yaarp, in particular, was named by Pleakley. *He is also one of the six known experiments to be rehabilitated by someone other than Lilo and Stitch, the other five being Gigi, Elastico, [[Spike (Lilo & Stitch)|Spike]], [[Frenchfry]], and [[Snooty]]. **Yaarp, alongside Spike, was rehabilitated by Pleakley. *Yaarp was named after a word from Pleakley's [[Plorgonar|home planet]]. *According to Jumba, Yaarp "was [his] first attempt to wreak havoc with high-decibel sonic disturbance, resonant compression, and oscillating vibrational distortion." He is designed to attack by firing balls of plasma from his scorpion-like tail. He was captured by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]], but was rescued in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]". ==Background== ===Physical appearance=== Plasmoid is a green scorpion-like creature with six legs, black eyes, an oval nose, two antennae, no pincers, and a pincer-less tail. He also has small fangs protruding from the top of his mouth, though they are larger and more prominent in ''[[Stitch!]]''. ===Powers and ablilties=== Plasmoid can shoot explosive balls of plasma from his tail. In the ''[[Stitch!]]'' anime, it is also revealed that he can vacuum up objects and then shoot them out his tail as projectiles after being transmutated by [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. ==Appearances== ===''[[Lilo & Stitch: The Series]]''=== Experiment 617 was the 617th genetic experiment created by [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] with [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]'s funding. He was designed to shoot plasma balls from his scorpion-like tail. 617 and the other first 624 experiments were deactivated and smuggled to Earth by Jumba during his mission to capture [[Stitch|Experiment 626]]. All of the experiment pods were released and scattered across the island of Kauai. 617's pod eventually made its way to a junk shop, where it (along with [[Hammerface|033]], [[Heat|609]], and [[Thresher|544]]) was found, stolen, activated, and named Plasmoid by [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] in "[[Dupe (episode)|Dupe]]". Back at [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]], Gantu trained and conditioned Hammerface, Heat, Thresher, and Plasmoid by simply using [[Reuben|Experiment 625]] for target practice, much to his indignity and chagrin. The four henchmen experiments were then led by Gantu in an attack on the [[Lilo's House|Pelekais' house]], where their boss ordered them to defeat and capture [[Stitch]] and his duplicates after seeing that he had been divided into four. While his teammates each battled one of the clones, Plasmoid engaged the original Stitch in a duel. Plasmoid attacked by firing plasma balls at Stitch, only for the latter to dodge them all. The scorpion-like experiment then fired a plasma blast at an overhead lamp. Stitch taunted Plasmoid, saying he missed, but this was proven wrong as the lamp then fell on Stitch's head, knocking him out. Gantu finished the battle by placing Stitch in a [[Prison Capsule|containment orb]] along with his clones. After capturing Stitch and his clones, the five returned to Gantu's ship for a victory feast (courtesy of Reuben), but were interrupted by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Pleakley]], and [[Dupe]]. When Lilo tricked Gantu into using Dupe's cloning ability, Gantu used Dupe to clone Plasmoid into a hundred replicas. However, as the original Plasmoid's power was divided among them, they all became complete weaklings, and thus were easily defeated. Presumably after this, they were all sent to [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] who was somehow able to remerge the weakling Plasmoid clones into the original. Although Plasmoid was unseen in "[[Woops (episode)|Woops]]", he is known to have been sent back to Gantu along with all of Hämsterviel's other captive experiments after [[Woops|Experiment 600]] caused chaos and nearly blew Hämsterviel's cover to the [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]]. Plasmoid reappeared in "[[Snafu (episode)|Snafu]]", and was freed along with Gantu's other captive experiments by Lilo, Stitch, and several other experiments in a rescue mission. Plasmoid even helped with the escape by breaking Gantu's [[Plasma Blaster|gun]] in two with a plasma blast, allowing [[Tank (Lilo & Stitch)|Tank]] to eat it. ===''[[Leroy & Stitch]]''=== The first 624 experiments, including Plasmoid, were rounded up by [[Leroy]] and taken to a stadium to be destroyed. However, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], [[Reuben]], and [[Captain Gantu|Gantu]] arrived before the experiments could be destroyed. Plasmoid participated in the following battle between the experiments and the [[Leroy Clones|Leroy clones]] by firing plasma blasts at attacking Leroys. However, the Leroys soon gained the upper hand in the battle, but were defeated when Lilo, Stitch, Reuben, and several other experiments performed the song "[[Aloha ʻOe]]", which caused the Leroy army to shut down due to the original Leroy's fail-safe. ===''[[Stitch!]]''=== Plasmoid has appeared twice in the ''Stitch!'' anime, both times with [[Splodyhead]]. In the first appearance, Plasmoid and Splodyhead combated [[Stitch]] when he was hypnotized by [[Swirly]] into fighting for [[Dr. Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. In the second appearance, Plasmoid and Splodyhead were modified by Hämsterviel to attack Stitch. Plasmoid was given a new ability of vacuuming up objects and using them as projectiles. In "Shogun", it is shown that Plasmoid was dehydrated back into an experiment pod and locked in [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s vault. Eventually, Jumba grabbed his pod to help Stitch in his fight against [[Dark End]], but Plasmoid wasn't one of the experiments that was activated. ==Gallery== {{Gallerylink}} ==Trivia== *Plasmoid is one of the ten known experiments named by someone other than Lilo or Stitch, the other nine being [[Gigi]], [[Elastico]], [[Yaarp]], [[Hammerface]], [[Heat]], [[Thresher]], [[Morpholomew]], [[Shrink]], and [[Leroy]]. **Plasmoid (alongside Hammerface, Heat, and Thresher) was named by Gantu. *Plasmoid, [[Bugby]], and [[Clink]] are the only known experiments that are hexapods. Interestingly, all three are different types of arthropods (arachnids, insects, and crustaceans respectively). *Plasmoid, [[Yang]], and [[Splodyhead]] are the only known experiments that shoot plasma/lava balls.
